title: Product Owner – HR, Attendance & Workforce Management
description:
Product Owner – HR, Attendance & Workforce Management

Location: Egypt

Business Environment: B2B Enterprise / GCC Markets

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner – HR, Attendance & Workforce Management to lead the functional ownership, continuous enhancement, and business evolution of our enterprise HR and Workforce Management solutions.

The selected candidate will be responsible for defining and maintaining the product vision, managing the product backlog and lifecycle, analyzing customer and business requirements, controlling scope, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet agreed business requirements and acceptance criteria.

The role covers HR, Attendance, Leave Management, Payroll Inputs, Overtime, End-of-Service (EOS), Workforce Management, biometric device integrations, ERP integrations, and Wage Protection Systems (WPS/SIF), where applicable.

The Product Owner will work closely with customers, Project Owners, QA, Sales, Support, and Technical Management.

The Product Owner is responsible for defining what needs to be delivered, why it is required, its business priority, and the acceptance criteria, while the Technical Management team remains responsible for the technical architecture, design, implementation approach, technical resource allocation, and deployment strategy.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Vision & Roadmap

* Define, maintain, and communicate a clear product vision and roadmap.

* Manage the evolution of HR, Attendance, Leave, Payroll, Overtime, EOS, and Workforce Management capabilities.

* Identify opportunities for product standardization and continuous improvement.

* Balance strategic product development with customer requirements and regulatory needs.

* Ensure product functionality remains aligned with applicable labor and regulatory requirements.

2. B2B Client Requirement Analysis

* Engage directly with HR, Finance, Operations, and IT departments of enterprise customers.

* Lead requirement-gathering and business-analysis sessions.

* Understand and document:

* Attendance policies

* Shift rules

* Flexible working rules

* Leave policies

* Overtime calculations

* Payroll inputs and deductions

* End-of-Service rules

* Approval workflows

* Reporting requirements

* Device and system integrations

* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.

* Coordinate with Technical Management regarding technical design and implementation requirements.

3. Product Backlog Ownership & Prioritization

* Own and maintain the Product Backlog.

* Create clear and complete User Stories.

* Define measurable Acceptance Criteria.

* Prioritize requirements based on:

* Business value

* Customer impact

* Regulatory requirements

* Severity

* Product strategy

* Dependencies

* Ensure development teams receive complete and approved requirements before implementation begins.

* Maintain visibility of backlog status, priorities, and pending decisions.

4. Change Request & Scope Management

* Review customer requests and correctly classify them as:

* Bug

* Change Request (CR)

* Enhancement

* New Requirement

* Configuration Requirement

* Determine whether requests fall within the agreed project/product scope.

* Prevent unapproved customer requests from being transferred directly into development activities.

* Assess the business impact and urgency of Change Requests.

* Coordinate with Technical Management to assess technical impact, effort, dependencies, and delivery feasibility.

* Coordinate with Sales and Management when a Change Request requires a commercial proposal, quotation, or customer approval.

* Maintain clear documentation and traceability of approved changes.

5. Integrations & System Connectivity

Oversee the functional requirements and business validation of integrations with:

* Biometric attendance devices

* Payroll systems

* ERP platforms

* Government platforms

* Wage Protection Systems (WPS/SIF)

* Third-party APIs and enterprise systems

Ensure that:

* Business integration requirements are clearly documented.

* Data mapping requirements are defined and validated.

* Expected synchronization behavior is clearly specified.

* Integration results meet agreed business requirements.

Technical architecture and implementation remain the responsibility of the Technical Management team.

6. UAT, Business Validation & Release Acceptance

* Define business acceptance criteria before development begins.

* Coordinate with QA to ensure test scenarios cover agreed business requirements.

* Review completed functionality against approved requirements.

* Lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with customers.

* Track UAT observations and ensure proper classification and resolution.

* Provide business acceptance before functionality is considered complete.

* Confirm that agreed business requirements have been successfully delivered before production release.

The Product Owner is responsible for business and functional acceptance, while QA remains responsible for functional testing, regression testing, defect validation, and test evidence.

7. Product Stability & Recurring Issues

* Monitor recurring production incidents from a business and customer-impact perspective.

* Identify patterns in recurring customer issues.

* Work with Support, QA, and Technical Management to prioritize permanent improvements.

* Participate in Root Cause Analysis where business rules or product behavior are involved.

* Ensure that recurring issues are addressed through product improvements rather than repeated temporary solutions.

* Monitor the accuracy and reliability of attendance, payroll-related calculations, and business reports.

Technical performance, database optimization, infrastructure, and code-level troubleshooting remain under Technical Management.

8. User Experience & Product Adoption

* Collaborate with UX/UI teams to improve the user experience.

* Simplify workflows, dashboards, forms, approvals, and reports.

* Analyze customer feedback and usability issues.

* Support customer demonstrations and product presentations when required.

* Support UAT and customer training initiatives.

* Improve product adoption through better functionality and usability.

9. Compliance, Access & Data Protection

* Ensure functional requirements properly address employee data confidentiality.

* Review business requirements related to roles, permissions, and access control.

* Ensure Role-Based Access Control requirements are properly defined.

* Consider applicable labor, payroll, and regulatory requirements during product development.

* Coordinate with Technical Management regarding technical security implementation.

10. Reporting & Product KPIs

Prepare periodic reports covering:

* Product roadmap progress

* Backlog status

* Open Change Requests

* Critical customer requirements

* UAT status

* Release readiness

* Recurring product issues

* Product usage and adoption

* Customer feedback

* Workforce Management

* Leave Management

title: AI-Native Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:

Our customers are moving fast to embed AI into their products and into the way they build software, using agentic tools to take work from idea to production.

What matters is solid engineering craft, real experience using AI agentically to ship code, and a readiness to grow into new technologies where the work needs it.

Please note: this is a hands-on software engineering role — you’ll be building and shipping AI-augmented features. It is not a Data Science, Machine Learning research, or model-training position. If your focus is statistics, model training, or data analysis rather than building software, this role isn’t the right fit.

Responsibilities

  • Build and ship full-stack web applications and AI-powered product features, from early idea to production release.

  • Use modern AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor as part of your daily engineering workflow — for research, prototyping, code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and documentation.

  • Review AI-generated code critically. Make sure it is reliable, maintainable, secure, and consistent with the team’s engineering standards.

  • Take part in architecture discussions, technical design, and code reviews. Help define reusable patterns and practical team practices for working with AI.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, delivery, and customer-facing teams. Understand not only what needs to be built, but also why it matters for the business.

  • Stay flexible with the stack. Strengthen your backend expertise while growing into frontend and cloud areas when the project requires it.

What we offer

  • Stable long-term cooperation and competitive compensation.

  • The chance to work at the cutting edge of agentic AI development on international projects.

  • A fast and well-structured onboarding process with a dedicated mentor.

  • A clear career development path and access to learning programs.

  • Paid vacation, national public holidays, and support during religious celebrations.

  • A modern and comfortable office based in Smart Village, at the heart of Cairo’s tech ecosystem.

  • Healthy work–life balance.

  • A welcoming corporate culture, team support, and respectful communication.

Requirements

What we expect from you

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, building web/product applications.

  • Strong command of at least one backend language: Node.js, TypeScript, Python, PHP, .NET / C#, or Java.

  • Solid full-stack fundamentals — comfortable working across APIs, databases, and deployment, not just a single layer.

  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted / agentic engineering tools in real delivery work (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Copilot CLI, or similar). We mean confident, fluent use — these tools are already a routine part of how you build and ship, not something you’ve only tried a few times.

  • Demonstrable experience with several of: prompt engineering for development workflows, multi-step agentic development, AI-assisted debugging and refactoring, AI-assisted test generation, and rapid prototyping with AI.

  • The judgment to use AI responsibly — understanding the limitations, risks, and governance considerations of AI-generated code.

  • A genuine readiness to learn and work in the front-end (any modern framework) when the work calls for it. Front-end experience is not required, but the right mindset is.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and drive work to production with little supervision.

  • Upper-Intermediate English level (B2).

  • A proactive mindset, good communication, and the ability to thrive in a high-impact, fast-paced environment.

Will be a plus

  • Front-end experience with a modern framework (React / Angular / Vue) and TypeScript.

  • Cloud fundamentals with one of the major platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP).

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Kubernetes.

  • Knowledge of message brokers (Kafka / RabbitMQ) and observability (ELK / Prometheus & Grafana).

  • Experience embedding AI/LLM features into products: RAG pipelines, vector databases (Pinecone / Qdrant), embeddings, and semantic search.

  • Experience building MCP servers/tools, custom “agent skills,” or multi-agent orchestration (e.g., LangChain / LangGraph).

  • Experience running self-hosted or local models (Ollama, vLLM).

title: Security Engineer - Network Access Control (NAC)
description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a Security Engineer – Network Access Control (NAC) with 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Network Access Control, network security, authentication, and endpoint access management.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in configuring, implementing, monitoring, and troubleshooting NAC solutions in enterprise network environments. The candidate will work closely with network, security, infrastructure, and customer teams to ensure secure and controlled access to wired and wireless networks.

Experience with NAC platforms such as Cisco ISE, Aruba ClearPass, FortiNAC, or Forescout will be preferred.


Key Responsibilities

1. Network Access Control

  • Configure, implement, and maintain Network Access Control solutions.
  • Manage network access policies for users, endpoints, devices, and different network segments.
  • Configure authentication and authorisation policies based on organisational requirements.
  • Support secure access for corporate, guest, BYOD, and IoT devices.
  • Monitor NAC environments and ensure access policies are functioning as expected.

2. 802.1X & Authentication

  • Configure and troubleshoot 802.1X authentication for wired and wireless networks.
  • Work with RADIUS, TACACS+, LDAP, and Active Directory authentication.
  • Troubleshoot authentication failures and endpoint access issues.
  • Work with certificates and authentication methods such as EAP-TLS.
  • Support user and device-based authentication policies.


3. NAC Implementation & Configuration

  • Configure NAC policies, profiles, authentication rules, authorisation rules, and endpoint classifications.
  • Perform endpoint profiling and device identification.
  • Configure VLAN assignment and role-based access policies.
  • Support NAC deployments across enterprise network environments.
  • Assist with NAC upgrades, migrations, policy changes, and implementation activities.


4. Network Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot network access and authentication-related issues.
  • Analyse NAC logs and identify the root cause of access failures.
  • Troubleshoot VLAN, DHCP, DNS, RADIUS, and connectivity-related issues.
  • Work with network switches, wireless controllers, firewalls, and other network infrastructure.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and customers to resolve technical issues.

5. Network Security

  • Implement network access policies based on security requirements.
  • Support endpoint compliance and posture assessment.
  • Identify unauthorised or non-compliant devices attempting to access the network.
  • Assist in implementing segmentation and role-based network access.
  • Support security monitoring and incident investigation related to network access

6. NAC Integration

Integrate NAC solutions with:

  • Active Directory
  • RADIUS
  • LDAP
  • DHCP
  • DNS
  • Network Switches
  • Wireless Controllers
  • Firewalls
  • SIEM / Security Monitoring Platforms
  • Endpoint Security Platforms


7. Customer & Project Support

  • Work with customers during NAC implementation and troubleshooting activities.
  • Participate in deployment, configuration, testing, and documentation.
  • Understand customer requirements and translate them into NAC policies.
  • Provide technical support during implementation and post-deployment activities.
  • Coordinate with OEMs and technology partners when required.


8. Monitoring & Reporting

Monitor and report:

  • Authentication failures
  • Endpoint onboarding status
  • Unauthorized devices
  • NAC incidents
  • Policy violations
  • Endpoint profiling
  • Network access issues
  • System health and availability

Prepare technical reports and maintain appropriate NAC documentation.

9. Documentation

  • Maintain NAC configuration documentation.
  • Document network access policies and authentication flows.
  • Prepare implementation and troubleshooting guides.
  • Maintain network diagrams and configuration records.
  • Ensure technical documentation is updated following changes or deployments.

10. Team Collaboration

  • Coordinate with Network, Security, Server, Cloud, and IT Infrastructure teams.
  • Work with OEM technical support teams when required.
  • Support senior engineers and technical managers during complex NAC implementations.
  • Participate in knowledge-sharing and technical training activities.


Required Skills

· Strong understanding of Network Access Control (NAC).

· Hands-on experience with at least one NAC platform:

· Cisco ISE

· Aruba ClearPass

· FortiNAC

· Forescout

· Good understanding of 802.1X authentication.

· Knowledge of RADIUS and TACACS+.

· Knowledge of Active Directory and LDAP.

· Understanding of TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, switching, and routing.

· Knowledge of wired and wireless network authentication.

· Experience in troubleshooting authentication and network access issues.

· Understanding of endpoint profiling and device classification.

· Basic understanding of network security concepts.

· Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.

· Excellent communication and coordination skills.

Preferred Experience

  • 2–3 years of experience in NAC / Network Security / Network Engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco ISE or Aruba ClearPass.
  • Experience working with enterprise network environments.
  • Experience with wired and wireless 802.1X implementation.
  • Experience integrating NAC with Active Directory and RADIUS.
  • Experience with endpoint profiling and posture assessment.
  • Knowledge of Cisco switching and wireless infrastructure.
  • Experience working in customer-facing implementation or support environments.
  • Relevant networking or security certifications will be an added advantage.

title: Community Lead
description:

The Community Lead will be responsible for creating an engaged community of active media and creative practitioners alongside establishing strategic partnerships across the region. The position will work closely with the Curator and regional Community Associates.

Main Duties and Responsibilities of the Job
Strategy Development:
  • Develop and implement a robust community and partnership strategy that aligns with Baraza Media Lab’s vision and growth objectives.

Events & Programming:

  • Gather insights and feedback from members to inform Baraza’s programming and strategy.

Team Leadership:

  • Coordinate with other Baraza offices to harmonize community experiences and share best practices.

  • Contribute to quarterly reflection and learning sessions within Baraza’s team.

Partnership Development:

  • Oversee and manage Baraza’s partnerships (particularly those that affect the community and members directly) in collaboration with the leadership team, ensuring strategic alignment and mutual value creation.

Networking & Ecosystem Growth:

  • Build strong relationships with media, technology, and creative industry players, expanding Baraza’s network and forming partnerships that advance the Lab’s mission.

Educational Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Media, Communications, Journalism, Creative Industries, Social Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • A master's degree or specialized training in community development, innovation, or media is advantageous.

Professional Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in community management, media, creative industries, or ecosystem building.

  • Proven success in developing and sustaining vibrant communities of media practitioners, technologists, or creatives.

  • Experience working within innovation hubs, media labs, or similar collaborative spaces.

  • Demonstrated ability to establish and manage strategic partnerships at regional or national levels.

  • Exceptional interpersonal, networking, and relationship-building skills.

  • Strong strategic thinking with experience developing community and partnership strategies.

  • Leadership skills with the ability to mentor regional community teams or associates.

  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written.

  • Familiarity with CRM tools, community engagement platforms, or project management software.

Personal Attributes

  • Passionate about media, storytelling, technology, and innovation.

  • Culturally sensitive, inclusive, and proactive in fostering diverse communities.

  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to work independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Inside sales project manager
description:

title: AI Developer –  For Chennai location
description:
About the Role


CogNet HR Solutions is seeking an AI Developer to design and build our AI-powered intelligent document processing and workflow automation platform which will process complex business documents such as PDFs, scanned documents, spreadsheets, forms, invoices, payroll reports, insurance documents, loss runs, applications, contracts, and other structured and unstructured data.


The AI Developer will work across the complete AI pipeline from document ingestion and classification through extraction, validation, reasoning, workflow automation, human review, and enterprise integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take AI solutions from prototype to secure, reliable production.


Preferred Technology Stack


AI / LLM: OpenAI APIs, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Hugging Face, vision-language models.


AI Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, and agent/tool-calling frameworks.


Programming: Strong Python proficiency; FastAPI, Pydantic, REST APIs, JSON and JSON Schema. Experience integrating AI services with C# / ASP.NET Core is highly desirable.


Document Processing: PyMuPDF/PDF libraries, OCR technologies, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, Document AI, OpenCV, and Excel processing.


Data: SQL Server/PostgreSQL, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, Redis or equivalent caching.


Cloud / DevOps: AWS, Docker, Git, CI/CD, S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch, SQS or equivalent messaging/queue technologies.


​











Requirements

Key Responsibilities


AI & LLM Development


· Design and develop AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).


· Build AI agents for document classification, extraction, validation, reasoning, and workflow execution.


· Develop structured extraction pipelines that convert unstructured documents into validated JSON and database records.


· Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and agent workflows.


· Evaluate models based on accuracy, latency, security, and cost.


· Build confidence scoring and human-review routing for exceptions.


· Implement guardrails and validation to minimize hallucinations and incorrect extraction.


Intelligent Document Processing


Build document-processing pipelines supporting: PDF / Images / Excel / Word / Email → Classification → OCR/Vision → AI Extraction → Validation → Business Rules → Human Review → API/Database.


· Document type detection and classification.


· OCR and vision-based document understanding.


· Table, form, key-value, and entity extraction.


· Multi-page processing, document splitting, and routing.


· Cross-document comparison and reconciliation.


· Confidence scoring, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop review.


· Structured JSON output generation.


Agentic Workflow Development


· Develop agents that identify document types and select appropriate extraction schemas.


· Extract and validate information against business rules.


· Compare multiple documents and identify missing or inconsistent information.


· Call APIs and enterprise systems and route documents to appropriate workflows.


· Generate summaries and recommendations and escalate exceptions for human review.


· Design reliable orchestration with retries, logging, fallbacks, and error handling.


Application & API Development


· Develop backend AI services and REST APIs.


· Integrate AI services with CogNet applications and third-party enterprise platforms.


· Build asynchronous/background processing for large document workloads.


· Design scalable queues and batch-processing capabilities.


· Implement secure API authentication and authorization.


Cloud & Production AI


· Deploy and operate AI applications on AWS.


· Build containerized applications using Docker.


· Implement scalable AI inference and document-processing architectures.


· Monitor model performance, latency, token consumption, failures, and cost.


· Implement production logging, monitoring, retries, and exception handling.


RAG & Enterprise Search


· Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and hybrid search.


· Chunking strategies, metadata filtering, document retrieval, and citation/source grounding.


· Enterprise document search or knowledge-management experience is an advantage.


AI Quality & Evaluation

title: Embedded Hardware Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Embedded Hardware Engineer

PCB Design and Development

Location:

New Delhi

Employment Type:

Full-time

Experience Level:

2-4 Years

Department:

Engineering / Electronics Hardware

Role Purpose

The engineer will translate product and electronics requirements into manufacturable, testable, and reliable hardware. The position requires sound engineering judgment across electrical performance, PCB constraints, component availability, electromagnetic compatibility, thermal behavior, safety, and production readiness. The engineer will work closely with firmware, mechanical, testing, manufacturing, and sourcing teams throughout the development cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • PCB development: Develop multilayer PCBs from requirements through schematic capture, layout, design review, fabrication outputs, assembly support, and final release.

  • Circuit design: Design and review analog, digital, mixed-signal, power, RF, and processor-based circuits using appropriate analysis, simulation, and engineering calculations.

  • Power electronics: Design power input stages, DC-DC converters, linear regulators, battery interfaces, protection circuits, filtering, grounding, current sensing, and power distribution networks.

  • RF communication: Develop PCB sections for wireless communication, including impedance-controlled routing, RF component placement, antenna interfaces, matching networks, filtering, grounding, isolation, and connector selection.

  • High-speed design: Route high-speed buses and interfaces using controlled impedance, differential pairs, length matching, return-path management, stack-up planning, termination, and signal-integrity principles.

  • Microprocessor routing: Design processor and microcontroller boards with reliable routing for clocks, memory, high-speed peripherals, power rails, reset, boot, debug, programming, and decoupling networks.

  • Component libraries: Create and maintain schematic symbols, PCB footprints, 3D associations, pin mappings, courtyard and assembly details, and land patterns for custom or non-standard components.

  • Engineering documentation: Prepare and maintain design calculations, schematics, bill of materials, fabrication and assembly drawings, stack-up requirements, test procedures, design-review records, and revision history.

  • Prototype validation: Support board bring-up, debug hardware faults, conduct functional and electrical testing, verify interfaces and power rails, and document corrective actions.

  • Production support: Work with PCB fabricators, assembly partners, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve manufacturability, assembly, component, and field issues.

Core Technical Areas

Area

Expected Knowledge and Application

Power integrity

Power-tree design, rail sequencing, decoupling, transient response, grounding, protection, efficiency, current capacity, voltage drop, ripple, and thermal performance.

Signal integrity

Trace impedance, differential routing, timing and skew, return paths, crosstalk control, via transitions, termination, and stack-up coordination.

RF design

Transmission-line behavior, RF layouts, matching networks, antenna connections, shielding, filtering, isolation, and practical RF measurement awareness.

Processor systems

Microcontrollers or microprocessors, memory, oscillators, reset and boot circuits, peripheral buses, debug interfaces, and high-density escape routing.

Component engineering

Datasheet interpretation, derating, tolerances, lifecycle and availability checks, approved alternatives, package verification, and library quality control.

Design for manufacture

Fabrication and assembly constraints, panel and test considerations, clearances, drill and via selection, solderability, inspection, and production test access.

Compliance awareness

EMI and EMC design practices, ESD and surge protection, electrical safety, environmental constraints, and applicable product requirements.



Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Embedded Systems, or a closely related discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience in schematic design and multilayer PCB layout for embedded electronic products.

  • Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, semiconductor devices, power supplies, interfaces, sensors, communication circuits, and practical board-level design.

  • Ability to read component datasheets, reference designs, standards, application notes, fabrication specifications, and assembly requirements accurately.

  • Hands-on ability to use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, logic analyzers, programmable power supplies, electronic loads, and relevant RF test equipment.

  • Working knowledge of a professional electronic design automation tool and disciplined library, version, and release-management practices.

  • Ability to investigate faults systematically and communicate technical findings through clear documentation and design reviews.

Preferred Experience

  • PCB development for defence, aerospace, industrial, automotive, robotics, communication, or other reliability-sensitive electronic products.

  • Simulation or analysis of power integrity, signal integrity, thermal performance, or RF behavior.

  • Hardware validation for EMI and EMC, environmental testing, reliability testing, and design qualification.

  • Collaboration with contract manufacturers and PCB fabrication vendors during new-product introduction and volume production.

  • Designing compact, high-density boards and custom footprints for unusual packages, connectors, sensors, modules, or mechanical constraints.

title: Finance Lead
description:
About Baraza Media Lab

Since 2019, Baraza Media Lab has provided a space for networking, collaborating, and experimenting among Kenya’s media practitioners. As a vibrant media and creative hub, BML fosters a dynamic community of storytellers, journalists, creators, technologists, and media professionals by providing a platform for knowledge sharing, innovation, training, convenings, incubation, and ecosystem-building.

As BML scales its programming, partnerships, hubs, and donor-funded work, the organization is strengthening its finance, procurement, and operational controls to support transparency, value for money, accountability, compliance, and audit readiness.

Purpose of the Role

The overall purpose of the Finance Lead role is to coordinate and strengthen BML’s finance and accounting function by ensuring that financial reporting and accounts payables are accurate, audit-ready and processed in a timely manner in line with approved policies, budgets, donor compliance expectations, and internal controls.

The role will support financial reporting, vendor management, documentation, supplier follow-up, fixed asset and inventory controls, and financial reporting. The Finance Lead will work closely with Procurement, Operations, Programs, HR, and hub teams to ensure timely and accurate reporting across the organization.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Oversee comprehensive reporting for all disbursements, including payroll, payables, and petty cash, ensuring accurate classification across the financial statements.

  • Guarantee that every expenditure is precisely allocated to the appropriate ledger, geographic location, funding stream, and cost category.

  • Ensure the Aged Payables report within the accounting system remains current, providing a clear view of vendor obligations, advances, and outstanding durations.

  • Manage prepayment amortization schedules and execute journal entries in strict accordance with established accounting principles.

  • Facilitate vendor management processes, encompassing supplier registration, banking detail validation, database maintenance, and payment status updates.

  • Record all supplier invoices accurately, verifying alignment with specific purchase orders and ensuring procurement has authorized payment based on successful delivery of goods or services.

  • Initiate all vendor payments and expense claims through the accounting system and banking platforms before final authorization.

  • Prepare and review monthly bank reconciliation, investigate variances and ensure all reconciling items are promptly resolved and appropriately documented.

  • Support month-end accounting close activities including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliation.

  • Conduct follow-ups for vendor receipt submission via Zoho Finance to verify successful fund transfers.

  • Confirm that all organizational spending adheres to current Kenyan statutory regulations.

  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation, filing and payment of all applicable statutory obligations including PAYE, VAT, withholding tax and other relevant taxes and maintain complete supporting records

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation, including purchase orders, supplier invoices, withholding tax certificates, banking transaction records and vendor receipts and support external, donor and statutory audits ensuring timely resolution of audit queries and findings.

  • Proactively identify and report financial risks, procedural gaps, potential fraud, or any instances of regulatory non-compliance.

  • Assist in the execution of controls related to procurement, inventory management, and asset tracking.

  • Manage all supplier data and internal records with the highest levels of integrity, fairness, and professional confidentiality.



Requirements

Qualifications, Skills and Competencies Required

  1. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.

  2. Possess at least 5 to 7 years of professional experience, specifically in finance support, accounts payable, or financial reporting.

  3. Holding professional accountancy certifications or related qualifications will be considered an asset.

  4. Demonstrate a thorough grasp of supplier management, payables workflows, internal controls, recordkeeping, and vendor payment cycles.

  5. Demonstrate a thorough grasp of financial reporting standards and methodologies concerning fixed assets, leasing, prepaid expenses, and accrual accounting.

  6. Proven track record in managing accounts payable functions is highly preferred.

  7. Proficiency in ERP and accounting platforms such as QuickBooks, Zoho, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics is advantageous.

  8. Exhibit exceptional skills in negotiation, communication, coordination, and organizational follow-up.

  9. Maintain the highest standards of accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and meticulous attention to detail.

  10. Ability to thrive within a fast-paced media hub, collaborating across departments in a donor-funded environment.

  11. Expertise in problem-solving and analysis, with a capacity to proactively flag control gaps, documentation issues, or financial risks.

title: R&D Scientist/Engineer – Reagents
description:
Job Title: R&D Scientist / Engineer – Reagents (Clinical Chemistry, ABG, FIA, CLIA)
Location: Hyderabad, India
Department: Research & Development – Diagnostics
Experience: 2–8 years (level mapped to seniority; freshers with M.Sc/PhD considered for junior roles)
Employment Type: Full-time, on-site

About Arni Medica
Arni Medica Private Limited is an ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 certified medical device and in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) manufacturer based at the Medical Devices Park, Sangareddy (Hyderabad), Telangana. We design and manufacture nephrology, infusion therapy, respiratory care and surgical disposables, and are building a full IVD diagnostics franchise spanning clinical chemistry, electrolyte/ISE, blood gas (ABG), fluorescence immunoassay (FIA) and chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) platforms — backed by Class 100K/10K cleanrooms, EtO sterilization and a CDSCO manufacturing licence (MFG/MD/2023/000942).

Role Overview
We are seeking an R&D Scientist/Engineer to develop, optimise, validate and transfer reagent formulations for our Electrolyte/ISE, ABG, FIA and CLIA platforms, with strong emphasis on analytical performance, stability and manufacturability. You will drive both new product development and continuous improvement of existing products while owning design-control documentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, formulate and optimise IVD reagents, calibrators, controls, buffers, conjugates and consumables across diagnostic platforms.
  • Develop assays across Clinical Chemistry (GOD-POD, Jaffe/enzymatic creatinine, CHOD-PAP lipids, turbidimetric CRP), ISE/electrolyte, ABG, FIA and CLIA.
  • Conduct design of experiments (DoE), stability studies (real-time/accelerated), forced degradation, interference and performance characterisation.
  • Establish analytical performance — accuracy, precision, linearity, LoB/LoD/LoQ and method comparison — per CLSI guidelines (EP05/EP06/EP09/EP25).
  • Author DHF / design-control documentation, verification & validation protocols, development reports, transfer documents and manufacturing instructions.
  • Lead reagent technology transfer R&D → manufacturing: scale-up, specification setting and lot-to-lot consistency studies.
  • Support complaint investigations, CAPA and product-performance troubleshooting with QA, QC, RA and Production.

Desired Candidate Profile

Education: M.Sc / PhD in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Chemistry or Immunology; or B.Tech/M.Tech in Chemical/Biomedical Engineering. PhD preferred for CLIA/immunoassay roles.

Experience: 2–8 years of hands-on IVD reagent/assay development. Junior (1–4 yrs), Senior/Scientist (4–8 yrs); strong M.Sc/PhD freshers considered for entry roles.

Technical Skills & Keywords

Assay development, reagent formulation, clinical chemistry, immunoassay, CLIA/chemiluminescence, FIA/fluorescence immunoassay, ELISA, ISE/electrolyte, blood gas/ABG, antibody conjugation, enzyme kinetics, calibrators & controls, spectrophotometry, turbidimetry, nephelometry, design verification & validation, CLSI (EP05/EP06/EP09/EP25), stability protocols, ICH, ISO 13485:2016, design control / DHF.

Preferred / Good to Have

  • Specific platform match — CLIA, FIA or ABG reagent development.
  • Antibody / conjugate chemistry and tech-transfer experience.
  • CDSCO MDR 2017 / ISO 13485 design-control documentation exposure.

What We Offer

  • A rare opportunity to help build a greenfield IVD diagnostics business from the ground up.
  • Modern, ISO 13485 / CDSCO-compliant manufacturing environment with cleanroom infrastructure.
  • Direct collaboration with R&D, Regulatory and senior leadership — visible impact, fast decisions.
  • Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience (negotiable; as per industry standards).
  • Accelerated career growth in a fast-scaling, export-oriented MedTech company.

title: MBSE Modeler - Advanced English proficiency
description:
MBSE MODELER - Advanced English proficiency

The opportunity

WSP is seeking an experienced Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) Modeler to support the development, maintenance, and governance of integrated system models for complex transportation, rail, infrastructure, and multidisciplinary engineering programs.

Working with System Architects, Systems Engineers, Requirements Managers, Interface Managers, and subsystem Subject Matter Experts, the successful candidate will translate engineering structures, requirements, functions, and interfaces into a coherent, traceable, and auditable SysML model. The role helps project teams identify integration risks and model inconsistencies before they become design, delivery, cost, or schedule issues.

What you will do

  • Translate Product Breakdown Structures (PBS) into logical SysML package structures and model hierarchies.

  • Translate PBS and System Breakdown Structures (SBS) into blocks, Block Definition Diagrams, Internal Block Diagrams, and related architectural views.

  • Represent safety related functional breakdowns, activities, system behavior, and allocations across system and subsystem levels to permit safety requirement apportionment between subsystems. Interface Hazard analysis and Interface Description Documents illustrations (Flow diagrams and Interface Diagrams)

  • Model hardware, software, logical, physical, and functional architectures based on input from architects, systems engineers, and SMEs.

  • Create and maintain packages, interface schematics, requirement containers, interface matrices, and traceability relationships.

  • Structure requirement containers to support synchronization (import / Exports) with requirements management platforms such as IBM DOORS or DOORS Next.

  • Maintain sufficient traceability among models, requirements, functions, components, interfaces, to trigger the generation of “Trees of Consequences” by the Requirement Management Tool based on the modification identified in the model up to verification methods, and supporting evidence.

  • Apply project modeling conventions, naming standards, configuration controls, and the Configuration Management Plan to maintain consistent model granularity and baselines.

  • Perform model audits and impact assessments to identify interface clashes, boundary effects, domino effects, duplicate elements, traceability gaps, and architectural inconsistencies. The Model Audit will be based on the standard audit functions coming with the chosen project MBSE tool or implemented and maintained by the MBSE tool to audit the Model.

  • Analyze and report anomalies detected during model development or modification, and support resolution with the responsible technical teams. The MBSE team reactivity is important to be able to detect potential border effects in design modification before any modification is approved and becomes complex to undo.

  • Participate in architecture workshops, model reviews, design reviews, interface reviews, and technical assurance activities.

  • Generate model reports, diagrams, matrices, and documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Contribute to reusable libraries, modeling methods, governance, and continuous improvement of MBSE practices.

Key deliverables

  • SysML Model packages and structured model trees

  • Block Definition Diagrams,Internal Block Diagrams, Flow Diagrams

  • Functional, logical, physical, hardware, and software architecture point of views

  • Interface schematics, interface matrices, and internal/external interface definitions

  • Requirement containers and traceability structures

  • Configuration-controlled model baselines The Modeler collaborates with the MBSE Administrator to stabilize a baseline from the branches and by participating in branch merging sessions to resolve conflict and “Diif” (Differences).

  • Model quality, audit, anomaly, and impact-assessment reports including real time reactivity and communication with teh design team when a clash is identified and participation in resolution.

What you will bring

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Practical experience developing and maintaining models for complex engineering or technology systems.

  • Working knowledge of systems engineering lifecycle processes, requirements management, system architecture, interface management, configuration management, and verification and validation.

  • Experience using SysML v1 and/or SysML v2 to represent system structure, behaviour, interfaces, requirements, and allocations.

  • Ability to interpret multidisciplinary engineering information and convert it into a structured and auditable model.

  • Experience collaborating with architects, systems engineers, discipline leads, SMEs, and project stakeholders.

  • Strong written communication, documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Technical knowledge and tools

  • Experience with one or more MBSE platforms such as Cameo Systems Modeler / MagicDraw, IBM Rhapsody, Capella, Sparx Enterprise Architect, PTC Modeler, or an equivalent SysML-compliant tool.

  • Familiarity with requirements management platforms such as IBM DOORS, DOORS Next, or an equivalent system.

  • Familiarity with Configuration Management Practices and the notions of CheckOut, Check In branches, tags, merges, diff and conflict resolution. Those competencies are essential for controlled asynchronous delocalized intervention on the models.

  • Knowledge of UML is valued. Software engineers with strong UML modeling experience and the ability to apply systems thinking are encouraged to apply.

  • Understanding of model governance, reusable libraries, configuration control, model quality checks, and digital engineering practices.

Preferred industry experience

  • Rail and transit systems or transportation infrastructure

  • Aerospace or avionics

  • Defence or military programs

  • Industrial plants, production lines, oil and gas facilities, pipelines, or refineries

  • Other large-scale, safety-critical, multidisciplinary systems integration programs

Key competencies

  • Systems thinking and the ability to understand relationships, dependencies, and change impacts across complex systems.

  • Attention to detail, consistency, traceability, and model quality.

  • Ability to work effectively without being the subsystem SME, while accurately interpreting and modeling the work of SMEs, System Engineers, and System Architects.

  • Clear communication and effective collaboration across technical disciplines and geographically distributed teams.

  • Curiosity, sound technical judgment, accountability, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

  • Ability to explain model content and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.

  • Availability to relocate to Bogotá or Medellín

title: Client Manager
description:
ABOUT ABN AUSTRALIA

At ABN Australia, we’re building something special, a place where your career can thrive without sacrificing balance or purpose. We help global businesses succeed in Australia, and we’re growing fast. If you’re looking for meaningful work, genuine flexibility, and a team that supports your growth, you’ll feel right at home with us.


Who We Are

ABN Australia is a fast-growing boutique corporate services firm helping international businesses launch and operate in Australia. From company setup and compliance to accounting and workforce services, we make business entry simple and seamless through our integrated, technology-driven approach.

A Global Perspective, a Local Team

You’ll work with clients from around the world, from start-ups to listed multinationals, gaining exposure to diverse industries and international operations. Our team is just as global, bringing together professionals from different cultures who share ideas, collaborate closely, and celebrate each other’s success.

Growth, Innovation, and Opportunity

We’re now entering an exciting new phase of growth that offers talented professionals the chance to make their mark and help shape the next chapter of our story.

Driven by Technology, Built on Flexibility

We’re a cloud-based, paperless firm leading the way in modern service delivery. Our systems are designed to help you work smarter, not harder, so you can focus on what matters most. With flexible work and leave policies, you can build a career that fits your life, not the other way around

What You'll Do

You will own the client relationship for a portfolio of B and C-tier international clients — acting as their trusted advisor as they operate and grow in Australia. You provide tax guidance, business and regulatory advice, and help clients navigate everything from entity structuring to payroll obligations to BAS compliance. For your clients, you are ABN Australia.

This is a client-facing advisory role, not an administrative or production role. You manage relationships, deliver advice, handle onboarding, and identify opportunities to add value.

2.1 CLIENT RELATIONSHIP OWNERSHIP (B/C-Tier Clients)

  • Act as the primary relationship owner and advisor for B and C-tier clients

  • Provide guidance on Australian tax obligations, regulatory requirements, and business operations, helping international clients understand how things work here

  • Advise clients launching in Australia on entity setup, registration obligations, employment framework, and ongoing compliance requirements

  • Lead client onboarding from engagement letter through to BAU: planning conversations, system setup, introductions to the technical team

  • Identify opportunities to deepen relationships and grow fees through additional services

  • Handle client queries and escalations directly — only escalating to the SCM for genuinely complex commercial or advisory matters

2.2 COMMERCIAL CONTRIBUTION

  • Own pricing conversations for B/C-tier engagements within the firm's value-based pricing framework

  • Deliver proactive communication throughout the compliance cycle: BAS summaries, deadline reminders, year-end planning

  • Track client engagement health: responsiveness, satisfaction, fee realisation, at-risk indicators

  • Support the SCM on business development activity: prospect meetings, proposals, referral follow-up

2.3 COLLABORATION ACROSS THE TEAM

  • Attend weekly pod sync meetings with the Senior Tax Manager and production team

  • Translate client priorities into clear briefs for the technical delivery stream

  • Coordinate with the offshore Client Manager who handles D/E-tier client communication

  • Support the SCM on A-tier client matters as needed this is your development exposure to more complex advisory work



Requirements

ABOUT YOU

You're a confident, client-facing advisor who international businesses trust to help them navigate Australia.

You combine accounting literacy with genuine commercial instinct — you understand what clients need, you explain it in plain language, and you make sure it happens.


Qualifications and Experience

  • Tertiary qualification in Commerce, Accounting, Business, or a related field

  • CPA / CA qualification preferred but not essential — commercial and advisory capability matters more than technical credentials

  • 3–7 years' experience in accounting, professional services, or a client-facing advisory role

  • Strong written and verbal communication — you write clear, professional emails and are confident advising senior finance professionals

  • Experience advising or supporting international businesses operating in Australia is highly valued

  • Familiarity with Australian tax and regulatory obligations at a conversational level — you guide clients, you don't prepare the returns

  • Familiarity with Xero, practice management software, or CRM systems is a plus


What We’re Really Looking For

  • Trusted advisor. Clients rely on you. You understand their business, anticipate their questions, and give them confidence that their Australian operations are in good hands.

  • Proactive, not reactive. You don't wait for clients to call with problems. You're ahead of them — flagging upcoming obligations, suggesting next steps, and keeping them informed before they have to ask.

  • Commercially aware. You understand that your portfolio drives retention and revenue. A well-advised, well-serviced client stays and grows. You spot opportunities to add value naturally.

  • Clear communicator. You translate tax and regulatory complexity into language international clients can act on. You bridge the gap between the technical team and the client.

  • Relentlessly organised. You track every open item, every deadline, every client commitment. Nothing gets lost. Nothing gets forgotten.

  • Adaptable. You're comfortable working across different client types, industries, and levels of complexity. No two days look the same and you like it that way.

  • Growth oriented. You want to develop into a Senior Client Manager. This role gives you direct exposure to higher-complexity advisory, pricing, and portfolio leadership under an experienced SCM — it's designed as that pathway.




Benefits

OUR VALUES AND CULTURE

All team members at ABN Australia are expected to demonstrate our core values every day:

  • Responsive by Nature – we always respond to customers within a few hours

  • Committed to Excellence – we are committed to excellence in everything we do

  • Continuously Improving – we recognise opportunities and strive to keep improving

  • Collaborative and Communicative – We work together and communicate openly to ensure all stakeholders are kept informed.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Role Overview

The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for leading the complete end-to-end testing lifecycle encompassing both manual and automated testing methodologies. This role involves conducting comprehensive testing of the product's existing and new features, designing robust automation frameworks, ensuring defect identification and resolution, and establishing a culture of high product quality and zero-defect thinking.

Working in close coordination with Development and Product Teams, the Sr. QAA brings deep QA expertise, disciplined execution, and strong quality standards to every testing engagement. The Sr. QAA serves as the primary quality point of contact during implementation and production support — ensuring that products are thoroughly tested, quality risks are identified and mitigated, and stakeholders are kept informed of testing progress and findings.



Roles & Responsibilities

1. Manual Testing Execution

  • Conduct comprehensive manual testing of web-based and desktop-based applications covering functional, integration, system, and UAT phases.
  • Execute exploratory testing to identify edge cases and potential defects.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality remains unaffected by changes.
  • Conduct user experience (UX) and usability testing to validate application usability.
  • Participate in UAT coordination and sign-off processes with stakeholders.

2. Automation Testing & Framework Design

  • Design and implement robust automation frameworks according to project structure and best practices.
  • Develop, design and execute automated tests using scripts and automation tools (Selenium, UFT, TestNG, etc.) to validate functionality.
  • Create and maintain reusable test libraries, utilities, and components to maximize code efficiency.
  • Implement data-driven testing approaches to test multiple scenarios with varied inputs.
  • Establish continuous integration (CI) pipelines for automated test execution.
  • Maintain and enhance test automation suites to ensure continuous coverage of critical application paths and regression prevention.
  • Document test automation architecture, design patterns, and maintenance guidelines.

3. Test Planning & Case Development

  • Create and implement detailed test cases for functional, unit, performance, security, and scalability testing.
  • Establish comprehensive test strategies tailored to product characteristics and client requirements.
  • Define test scenarios, test data requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and test executions.

4. Security Testing & Vulnerability Assessment

  • Conduct comprehensive security testing to identify vulnerabilities, security flaws, and compliance gaps in applications.
  • Perform SQL injection testing, cross-site scripting (XSS) testing, cross-site request forgery (CSRF), and authentication/authorization testing.
  • Execute load and stress testing to validate application behavior under extreme conditions and identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Identify and document security risks, data protection issues, potential exploits, and compliance concerns.
  • Validate secure data transmission, encryption protocols, secure session management, and SSL/TLS implementations.
  • Test API security, OAuth/JWT authentication mechanisms, role-based access control (RBAC), and permission enforcement.
  • Perform penetration testing and vulnerability assessment to simulate real-world attacks.
  • Coordinate with Development and Security teams to remediate identified security issues and implement secure coding practices.
  • Ensure adherence to security standards and regulatory compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, etc.) as applicable.

5. Defect Identification & Quality Assurance

  • Detect and minimize bugs, errors, technical, security, and functional flaws in applications.
  • Establish quantitative trends of types of bugs and their recurring frequency for continuous improvement.
  • Outline steps for minimizing defects and preventing recurrence.
  • Ensure thorough defect management through proactive follow-up and feedback with Development Teams.

6. Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare comprehensive Test Result Reports (TRR) for each tested release.
  • Ensure immediate discussion with Technology Team for validation of observations in TRR.
  • Maintain detailed testing documentation and execution logs.
  • Generate meaningful reports on testing progress, defect metrics, security findings, and quality trends.

7. Quality Culture & Process Adherence

  • Establish and promote culture of 'High Product Quality' and 'Zero Defect' amongst Development and Product Teams.
  • Follow defined standard practices and methodologies for testing and defect tracking.
  • Suggest new tools and techniques to improve test efficiency, automation coverage, and overall QA strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies including Travel Policy, Information Security (INFOSEC) Policy, and other applicable guidelines.


Requirements

Qualification / Skill-sets

  • B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / MCA or other Technical Graduates with formal course-work in Software Development, Testing or Quality Assurance
  • Certification in Software Testing or Automation Testing
  • 3+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Software Testing profile for Software solutions
  • In-depth knowledge of Software Testing Process and methodologies is a pre-requisite
  • Sound understanding of Functional Testing and .Net platform (especially ASP.Net) is expected
  • Hands-on experience with both manual testing and automation testing frameworks
  • Knowledge of Security Testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment, and security risk identification
  • Understanding of OWASP Top 10, common web application vulnerabilities, and security best practices
  • Keen desire to research and learn emerging testing techniques and ability to incorporate these meaningfully in products
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to identify root causes and structure solutions
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with ability to engage confidently with stakeholders

Added Advantage Qualification / Skill-sets

  • Hands-on experience on all types of Software Testing methodologies (Black Box, White Box, Grey Box, etc.)
  • Specialization in Security and/or Automated Testing
  • Hands-on experience on Selenium/Unified Functional Testing (UFT) or similar automation tools

  • Sound interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams

title: Reinstatement Operative
description:
Comex 2000 is currently seeking experienced and reliable Reinstatement Operative to support our telecoms delivery programme across the North West. If you are a motivated contractor who takes pride in delivering high-quality reinstatement works and can work independently to agreed standards, we would like to hear from you.

This role is offered under the Construction Industry Scheme (CIS).

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a skilled Reinstatements Operative to carry out permanent and interim reinstatement works following telecoms excavation activities within the public highway and customer premises. You will be responsible for restoring footways, carriageways and verges to industry standards while working in accordance with current legislation, health and safety requirements and client specifications.

The ideal candidate will have experience in tarmac and asphalt reinstatement works, be comfortable working within small gangs or independently, and demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, quality and productivity.

What will you be doing?

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Carrying out interim and permanent reinstatements to footways, carriageways and verges in accordance with NRSWA specifications.
  • Undertaking tarmac and asphalt laying, including raking, screeding and compaction activities.
  • Operating rollers, Stihl Saws, Wacker Plates, Trench Compactors and other associated plant and equipment while maintaining appropriate certifications.
  • Delivering patching, white top and other highway reinstatement works to required standards.
  • Restoring highways and public areas following excavation and repair works, ensuring all evidence, data and photographs are accurately captured using approved systems.
  • Supporting highway, utility and telecoms reinstatement activities across multiple work locations.
  • Working effectively within 2-man and 3-man gangs and, where required, taking responsibility for coordinating site activities.
  • Supporting traffic management arrangements, including flagging and traffic control where required.
  • Identifying and rectifying defects to ensure compliance with client, local authority and industry requirements.
  • Completing all required paperwork and records, including job sheets, risk assessments, plant inspections and vehicle checks.
  • Demonstrating strong risk assessment and hazard identification skills, with a clear focus on health and safety.
  • Managing workloads effectively to ensure works are completed safely, efficiently and within agreed timescales.
  • Delivering high-volume production work while maintaining quality standards and a right-first-time approach.
  • Working to site specifications, programme requirements and client deadlines at all times.


Requirements

Skills and Qualifications

  • Good physical health and fitness.
  • Proven experience in reinstatement works within telecommunications, utilities, highways or civil engineering environments.
  • Experience in tarmac and asphalt laying, raking and screeding.
  • Experience operating rollers and other reinstatement plant and equipment.
  • Experience completing patching and permanent reinstatement works.
  • Experience working on highways and utility projects.
  • Experience working within or leading 2-man and 3-man gangs.
  • Knowledge of traffic management, flagging and traffic control practices.
  • Strong understanding of health and safety responsibilities and safe working practices.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to manage workloads and maintain productivity in a high-volume operational environment.
  • Industry-recognised Street Works qualifications.
  • Full UK Driving Licence.
  • NRSWA Units 1-9 (Essential).
  • SA002a (Desirable).


Benefits

What can we give back to you?

  • Competitive self-employed rates.
  • Consistent volumes of work across the North West.
  • Long-term contracting opportunities with one of the UK's leading telecommunications delivery partners.
  • Support from experienced operational and planning teams.
  • Opportunities to increase earnings through additional work streams and program growth.
  • Prompt and reliable payment arrangements.
  • The opportunity to build a lasting working relationship with an established and growing business.

Who are we?

With a core focus on network build, installation and maintenance nationally, Comex 2000 is an established partner of choice in the telecommunications industry. For over 20 years, Comex 2000 has provided a full turnkey service, connecting homes and businesses across the UK.

With more than 1,000 people delivering projects nationwide, we continue to support some of the country's largest telecommunications providers, including Virgin Media, Community Fibre, Gigaclear and Zayo.

Our success is built on working with professional, highly skilled operatives and contracting partners who share our commitment to quality, safety and a right-first-time approach. As our network continues to grow, we are looking to build long-term relationships with dependable self-employed reinstatement professionals who can help us deliver industry-leading standards for our clients and customers.

If you are an experienced Self-Employed Reinstatement Operative looking for regular work opportunities, competitive rates and long-term prospects across the North West, we would welcome your application.

title: Senior Manager, Estimating
description:
We are IAMGOLD. Innovative, Accountable Mining.

IAMGOLD is a Canadian-based gold mining company with operations and development projects across North America and West Africa. With flagship operations like the Côté Gold Mine in Ontario, one of Canada’s largest and most technologically advanced gold mines, we’re not just mining gold; we’re redefining what mining means for the future.

At IAMGOLD, we believe that when we engage, empower, and support each other, we create extraordinary outcomes—delivering value for our people, partners, and stakeholders while building stronger, more resilient communities.
Recognized as one of the 2025 GTA Top Employers, we offer an environment designed for growth, world-class rewards, cutting-edge development programs, and a culture that values fresh ideas and collaboration.

Our results speak for themselves\: ranked 13th on the 2025 TSX30, we’ve proven that performance and purpose go hand in hand. Here, you’ll work on projects that matter, leveraging technology, sustainability, and creativity to deliver impact for our teams, communities, and the planet.

Innovation drives us. Sustainability anchors us. Accountability shapes us.

Want to Learn More About IAMGOLD?

  • Check out the IAMGOLD Blog
  • Read about our Sustainability Approach

About the role\:

IAMGOLD is seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager, Estimating to serve as the Company's technical authority on capital cost estimating and support informed investment decisions across our portfolio of growth and sustaining capital projects. This role will lead the development of capital cost estimates for major mining projects and establish the standards, methodologies, and governance processes that drive consistency, accuracy, and reliability across the organization.


Working closely with project, engineering, construction, procurement, finance, and operations teams, the Senior Manager will oversee estimating activities from early-stage concept development through feasibility studies and execution planning. The role will provide expert guidance on estimating best practices, ensure alignment with IAMGOLD's capital project framework, and support decision-making through robust cost analysis and forecasting.

Responsibilities\:

In this role, you will provide leadership in the development and delivery of capital cost estimates for major growth and sustaining capital projects, supporting initiatives from early concept development through feasibility studies and execution. You will establish and maintain estimating standards, procedures, methodologies, and governance frameworks while ensuring all estimates are supported by robust documentation and aligned with organizational requirements. You will also manage the corporate estimating database, historical cost information, benchmarking data, and productivity metrics to improve estimate accuracy, forecasting, and overall project performance.

As a key contributor to project success, you will perform estimate assurance activities including risk analysis, contingency development, escalation forecasting, and independent reviews of consultant, contractor, and vendor estimates. Working collaboratively with project controls, engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and operations teams, you will provide expert estimating guidance and support informed decision-making throughout the project lifecycle. You will communicate estimates and recommendations to senior leaders and investment committees, while managing external estimating resources to ensure high-quality deliverables and alignment with corporate standards.

title: Testing Engineer
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Tester to join our software company, specializing in enterprise-grade ERP web and mobile applications. In this role, you will lead and execute comprehensive testing strategies spanning backend web APIs, Angular web frontends, and Flutter mobile applications. You will be responsible for end-to-end QA activities including manual test case writing, stress and performance testing, automation testing, and bug reporting, while actively researching and leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to enhance test suite efficiency and automation.


Key Responsibilities

[High Priority] Analyze requirements and ERP business workflows (such as ERP business logic, data integrity, and role-based access controls) to design, write, and execute comprehensive test cases and test scenarios across Web, Mobile (Flutter), and Web APIs (), using Google Sheets and Jira for test management.

[High Priority] Engineer comprehensive test plans, standardized manual test sheets, standardized bug reporting processes, and acceptance criteria in Google Sheets and Jira for early defect detection and end-to-end testing lifecycle management across client applications.

[Medium Priority] Perform stress, load, and performance testing using Apache JMeter to validate system stability, scalability, and backend reliability under heavy load.

[Critical Priority] Architect, execute, and maintain automated testing scripts and regression suites using Java with Selenium WebDriver and TestNG or TypeScript with Playwright (TypeScript Playwright preferred), applying the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern across UI, web, mobile, and API layers to support continuous integration and automated functional testing.

[Medium Priority] Research, evaluate, and integrate AI-powered agentic testing frameworks (such as Healwright) to drive self-healing test automation, script resilience, and improve overall QA suite efficiency.

[High Priority] Conduct specialized backend and API validation using Postman to verify endpoint responses, data formatting, and error handling; create detailed bug reports, perform root-cause analysis using fundamental web, OOP, and database technical foundations, and collaborate closely with cross-functional development teams (, Angular, Flutter) to track and verify defect fixes.

[High Priority] Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and retrospectives using Jira, Git, and Maven to estimate user stories, clarify requirements, manage version control, and drive defect tracking throughout the release lifecycle.

Requirements

Job Requirements

  • Domain Experience & Core Responsibilities: Strong knowledge of ERP business processes, complex workflow validation (e.g., ERP business logic, data integrity, access control), and enterprise-grade application testing in a software development environment.

  • Technical Stack & API Validation: Hands-on testing experience across Web APIs, Angular web applications, and Flutter mobile applications; proficiency with specialized API testing via Postman (endpoint verification, data formatting, error handling) and performance/load testing using Apache JMeter.

  • Testing Methodologies, Tools & Agile Management: Solid understanding of ISTQB Foundation principles, test planning, manual test case design, defect tracking (Jira), version control (Git, Maven), software development lifecycles (SDLC), and Agile management practices.

  • Automation & Agentic AI: Proven capability in architecting and maintaining UI/Functional automated testing scripts using Playwright (TypeScript preferred) or Selenium WebDriver with TestNG (Java) using POM, combined with Agentic AI testing tools/frameworks like Healwright for self-healing script resilience.

Technical Foundation & Continuous Research: Solid grasp of technical foundations (JavaScript, HTML, OOP, database management) for root cause analysis, alongside a proactive mindset toward continuous learning and modern QA methodologies.

title: Alterna Fellowship Program

Tackle real-world challenges, needs, and opportunities

Experience

Career advancement

Opportunities for mentors to engage

Key Accountabilities:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Degree qualification in Science, Technical, Quality, Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in the biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical industry.
  • No graduate-level candidates; relevant industry experience is required.
  • Strong experience within a biopharmaceutical Quality Control/Analytical Laboratory environment.
  • Experience with UPLC, Capillary Electrophoresis (CE), and PA800.
  • Experience with raw materials testing and release.
  • Experience with deviations, investigations, compliance, and quality systems.
  • Experience supporting stability testing, drug substance testing, and analytical validation activities.

  • Technical & Analytical Aptitude: General knowledge of modern enterprise software architectures, with hands-on system configuration experience considered a strong asset.



Benefits

title: Werfleider Sanitair

title: Field Officer (LHF Project)
description:
General Objective

The Field Officer contributes to the implementation of the Social Unit's mission by supporting the identification, assessment, accompaniment, and empowerment of vulnerable individuals and communities through effective outreach, coordination, and documentation, while ensuring quality service delivery, inclusion, and respect for beneficiaries' rights in accordance with arcenciel's values and objectives.


General Tasks

1. Outreach and Beneficiary Identification

  • Conduct community outreach and identification of potential beneficiaries.
  • Conduct interviews to collect household’s socio-economic data and documentations.
  • Collect feedback from beneficiaries.
  • Support in service mapping by identifying available local services and community resources.
  1. Field monitoring and follow-up
  • Conduct field visits, home visits and follow-up visits as assigned and in coordination with the Social Worker.
  • Follow up with beneficiaries according to the established follow-up plan.
  • Report changes in beneficiaries' situations, concerns, or emerging needs to the Social Worker.
  • Support the monitoring of activities and services delivered at community level.

3. Social Support

  • Assist beneficiaries in accessing referred services.
  • Verify information provided by beneficiaries when required.
  • Support distribution or delivery of approved assistance when relevant.
  • Coordinate closely with the Social Unit team and other arcenciel departments, according to established procedures.
  1. Documentation and reporting
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date beneficiary and field activity records.
  • Prepare field visit reports and other documentation as required.
  • Ensure that information collected in the field is transmitted accurately and in a timely manner to the Social Unit.
  • Contribute to the preparation of activity reports and statistics.

5. Quality, Compliance, and Organizational Commitment

  • Respect arcenciel's policies, procedures, code of conduct, and safeguarding principles.
  • Ensure confidentiality and ethical handling of beneficiary information.
  • Perform any other related tasks assigned by the supervisor that support the objectives of the Social Unit and arcenciel.

Working Conditions

  • Job Constraints : Frequent travel throughout Lebanon, Exposure to challenging social and economic situations, Occasional work outside regular office hours during activities, emergencies, or special events
  • Tools, Software used: Microsoft Office
  • Workplace: Office-based work in additional to frequent travel across Lebanon.
  • Working Schedule: Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM
  • Type of contract: 9 months with possibility of renewal depending on funding
  • Probation period: 3 months



Requirements

Skill set and competencies

  • Ability to identify individual needs, risks, vulnerabilities, and appropriate support and referral pathways.
  • Understanding of community service techniques and practices.
  • Empathy and active listening.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Adaptability and flexibility.
  • Respect for diversity and inclusion.
  • Commitment to confidentiality and professional ethics
  • Knowledge of social case management principles and practices.
  • Strong interviewing, assessment, and communication skills.
  • Report writing and documentation basic skills.
  • Awareness on human rights, safeguarding, protection, and inclusion principles
  • Emotional and Self resilience
Languages

Arabic and English are required. French is a plus.

Level of education and Experience

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, Social Sciences, Education, Public Health, or a related field. In addition to 1-2 years of experience in social work, community development, humanitarian work, etc
