title: Global Document Coordinator — Major Projects Delivery (MPD)
description:
Global Document Coordinator — Major Projects Delivery (MPD)

1. Role Objective

The Global Document Coordinator is the programme’s dedicated specialist for the InEight Document module. The role operates at the same level as the Global Technical Coordinator and reports to the Global Implementation Lead, with a focused mandate\: owning the administration, configuration, and deployment of InEight Document across all MPD implementations.

A key reason this role exists as a dedicated function — rather than being absorbed into the broader Global Technical Coordinator or Digital Coordinator responsibilities — is the architecture of InEight Document itself. Unlike other InEight modules, Document fuses system administration with project-level configuration. Setting up a project in the Document module requires the same person to hold both system-level access and project configuration authority simultaneously. This means the general platform administrator (Digital Coordinator) cannot perform Document project setup without also holding system admin rights to the Document module, and the general technical coordinators cannot configure Document without dedicated module proficiency. A specialist who holds both responsibilities for Document specifically is therefore a structural necessity, not a staffing preference.

Beyond technical setup, the role brings deep document control and information management expertise into the programme, ensuring that WSP’s InEight Document implementations are compliant with applicable international standards (ISO 9001, ISO 19650) and reflect sound document management practice across all project types and regions.

2. Key Responsibilities

2.1 InEight Document — System Administration & Project Configuration

• Hold and exercise both system administration rights and project configuration authority for the InEight Document module across the MPD programme.

• Configure the Document module for each new project activation, including document type setup, numbering schemes, workflow definitions, transmittal rules, access controls, role assignments, and integration with related InEight modules.

• Maintain the Document module system environment, including user provisioning, permission governance, template management, and version control of system-level configuration standards.

• Coordinate with the Digital Coordinator & Information Manager on overall InEight platform administration boundaries, ensuring that Document system administration is governed consistently within the programme’s broader platform management framework.

• Coordinate with the Global Technical Lead on Document module configuration standards, quality gate requirements, and platform-level decisions affecting the Document module.

2.2 Document Management Standards & Compliance

• Define and maintain the MPD document management standard for InEight Document implementations, ensuring alignment with ISO 9001 (quality management) and ISO 19650 (information management for the built environment) requirements.

• Translate project-specific document management requirements — including client requirements, contractual obligations, and internal WSP standards — into compliant InEight Document configurations.

• Assess regional and project-level document management practices during readiness phases, identifying gaps against the global standard and defining remediation steps before configuration begins.

• Maintain a controlled library of Document module configuration templates, workflow definitions, transmittal register structures, and document type taxonomies for reuse across implementations.

2.3 Implementation Coordination — Document Workstream

• Lead the Document module workstream within each MPD implementation, coordinating with the assigned Global Technical Coordinator, Regional SMEs, project document controllers, and project teams.

• Facilitate Document-specific workshops and working sessions with project stakeholders to define document control processes, approval workflows, distribution matrices, and records management requirements.

• Manage Document module readiness assessments, configuration reviews, user acceptance testing, Go-Live preparation, and post-Go-Live stabilisation for each implementation.

• Escalate Document module risks, issues, and configuration decisions to the Global Implementation Lead; coordinate with the Global Technical Lead on platform-level concerns via the GIL.

2.4 Training Delivery — Document Module

• Complete the MPD Train-the-Trainer programme with a Document module specialisation focus, maintaining platform and process proficiency required to support implementations globally.

• Deliver InEight Document training to project document controllers, Regional SMEs, and project teams in English and Spanish, covering system navigation, workflow execution, transmittal management, and document control procedures.

• Develop and maintain Document-specific training materials, quick-reference guides, configuration handbooks, and user documentation aligned with the global programme standard.

• Track Document module training completion and readiness across active implementations, reporting to the Global Implementation Lead.

2.5 User Adoption & Process Integration

• Support the GBO’s OCM strategy at the project level for the Document module workstream, coordinating user enablement and adoption activities in line with programme direction.

• Coordinate the integration of InEight Document workflows with related project delivery processes, including engineering deliverables management, contractor submittals, client transmittals, and records management.

• Support sustainable post-Go-Live Document module ownership by coordinating handover to regional document controllers and defining ongoing support and escalation routes.

2.6 Continuous Improvement & Programme Contribution

• Maintain awareness of InEight Document product developments and assess their relevance to WSP’s implementation standard, feeding recommendations to the Global Technical Lead.

• Identify and document lessons learned from Document module implementations, contributing to the continuous improvement of configuration templates, training materials, and deployment procedures.

• Participate in programme-wide coordination sessions and support the development of the global Document management framework alongside the Global Technical Lead and Global Business Owner.

3. Required Profile

3.1 Experience — Essential

• Minimum 8 to 12 years of relevant professional experience, with 10 years preferred, including at least 5 years in document control, document management, or information management on complex engineering or construction projects.

• Demonstrated expertise in document control practice on major projects, including document numbering systems, transmittal management, approval workflows, revision control, records management, and document distribution.

• Experience in project-intensive environments such as EPC, EPCM, engineering consulting, construction, infrastructure, mining, power, or energy, where formal document control frameworks are applied contractually.

• Practical knowledge of ISO 9001 (quality management systems) and ISO 19650 (information management for the built environment, including BIM), with experience applying these standards in a project or programme context.

• Strong coordination and stakeholder capabilities, including workshop facilitation, management of concurrent multi-project document control workstreams, and Microsoft 365 proficiency.

• C1 level English proficiency (mandatory) — the role requires confident written and verbal communication with global stakeholders.

3.2 Experience — Desirable

• Hands-on experience with InEight Document or comparable enterprise document management platforms such as Aconex, Procore, Bentley ProjectWise, SharePoint (document management configuration), or equivalent EDMS/PMIS platforms used on major projects.

• Experience with InEight Document system administration and project configuration is highly desirable — candidates with this background will be prioritised.

• Experience implementing or configuring document management systems across multiple projects, offices, or regions, including workflow design, access control governance, and integration with broader project controls or ERP environments.

• Familiarity with Primavera P6, Power BI, SharePoint, and collaborative programme management tools such as Jira.

• Portuguese proficiency and relevant certifications (RIM, CIP, PMP, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent document management or project management qualifications) are considered assets.

3.3 Education

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, information management, records management, project management, or a related discipline.

• Candidates with an alternative combination of relevant education, professional certification, and substantial document management implementation experience may also be considered.

• Document control, information management, quality management, or project management certifications are an asset.

4. Train-the-Trainer Commitment

All Global Coordinators are required to complete the MPD Train-the-Trainer programme upon joining. This consists of self-directed learning through InEight University, facilitated training sessions delivered by InEight, and a competency assessment conducted by the Global Technical Lead. Certification is issued by the Global Business Owner upon successful completion.

For the Global Document Coordinator, the Train-the-Trainer programme is completed with a Document module focus. The postholder is expected to achieve full proficiency in the InEight Document module, covering all configuration, administration, and workflow capabilities relevant to WSP’s implementation scope.

5. Key Interfaces

• Global Implementation Lead — line manager; all escalations, implementation direction, and deployment assignments.

• Global Technical Lead — Document module configuration standards and quality gate; coordination via the GIL.

• Digital Coordinator & Information Manager — platform administration boundaries, programme information environment, and data governance coordination.

• Global Technical Coordinators — implementation coordination counterparts; Document workstream integration within broader project activations.

• Regional Business Owners & Regional PDE Leads — regional counterparts during active implementations.

• Regional SMEs — Document module training and configuration support.

• Project Document Controllers — primary training recipients and day-to-day Document module counterparts at project level.

• InEight CSM Team — Document module platform support and Train-the-Trainer coordination.

6. Success Measures

• Successful InEight Document module activations across prioritised projects, achieving approved configuration milestones, Go-Live readiness, and compliant document control frameworks aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 19650.

• Established and maintained Document module configuration templates, workflow libraries, and training materials that enable consistent, repeatable deployment across regions and project types.

• Sustainable post-Go-Live Document module ownership at project level, evidenced by trained document controllers, defined support routes, and positive stakeholder feedback on process clarity and system usability.

title: Planner
description:
Als Planner bij Clima & Partners ben je verantwoordelijk voor het coördineren en plannen van onze service en onderhoud techniekers. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze techniekers efficiënt en effectief worden ingezet om aan de behoeften van onze klanten te voldoen. Je speelt een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van klanttevredenheid door nauwkeurige planning en tijdige opvolging. Door gevoel voor detail en het vermogen om meerdere taken tegelijk te beheren, ben jij zeer georganiseerd en nauwkeurig. Jouw sterke communicatieve vaardigheden stellen je in staat om effectief te communiceren met klanten, leveranciers en collega’s. Je bent proactief in het oplossen van problemen en blijft kalm onder druk, wat cruciaal is voor het halen van deadlines. Als teamspeler werk je graag samen en draag je bij aan een positieve werksfeer binnen het team. Deze kwaliteiten maken jou de ideale kandidaat voor de rol van Planner van onze service en onderhoudstechniekers.

Takenpakket:

  • Het inplannen en coördineren van de werkzaamheden van de service en onderhoud techniekers is jouw hoofdverantwoordelijkheid.
  • Communiceren met de klanten, zowel telefonisch als per mail.
  • Bij last minute veranderingen bel je alsnog met een glimlach met de klant om dit recht te zetten.
  • Opmaken en verwerken van werkbonnen in functie van het onderhoud.
  • Onderhouden van de contacten met leveranciers vanwege de nodige materialen.
  • Problemen of vastgestelde defecten opvolgen met de afdeling na-service.
  • Inplannen van de werkzaamheden in samenspraak met verschillende afdelingen.
  • Werken met basis softwarepakketten en een ERP-systeem.


Vereisten

  • Relevante werkervaring als planner voor techniekers komt zeker goed van pas.

  • Gemotiveerde mensen die iets negatiefs kunnen ombuigen naar iets positief.

Voordelen

title: IT Architecture Consultant
description:
• Scope of Work

    1. Overall Systems Architecture

  • Investia technology layer

  • APIs

  • data layer

  • workflow engine

  • AI capabilities

  • External services

  • eKYC

  • AML/sanctions screening

  • payment/banking systems

  • Financial back office

  • TEA Computers MFMS/ICSS or equivalent systems

  • External financial infrastructure

  • banks

  • custodians

  • MCDR and other relevant parties where required.

    2. TEA Computers Technical Review

  • Review TEA’s current proposal and advise Investia on:

  • minimum required TEA modules;

  • MFMS requirements;

  • ICSS production requirements;

  • UAT requirements;

  • API requirements;

  • whether the TEA mobile application is necessary;

  • Oracle requirements;

  • Microsoft SQL requirements;

  • WebLogic requirements;

  • server/cloud requirements;

  • disaster-recovery requirements;

  • annual maintenance requirements; and

  • potential areas of vendor lock-in.

  • The consultant should participate in technical discussions with TEA on behalf of Investia where required.

    3. API Architecture

  • Define the API architecture connecting:

  • Investia applications;

  • TEA Computers;

  • eKYC providers;

  • AML providers;

  • payment systems;

  • banks;

  • external financial institutions;

  • future partners; and

  • future white-label clients.

  • The architecture should allow Investia to replace individual vendors in the future without rebuilding the entire platform.

    4. Infrastructure Architecture

    Recommend the appropriate infrastructure for:

  • production;

  • UAT;

  • disaster recovery;

  • backup;

  • database hosting;

  • application hosting;

  • cybersecurity;

  • monitoring; and

  • system administration.

    The consultant should evaluate:

  • cloud versus physical servers;

  • Oracle and SQL licensing;

  • infrastructure sizing;

  • data localisation requirements;

  • availability requirements; and
    * five-year expected infrastructure costs.

    5. Cybersecurity and Data Governance

    Define minimum requirements for:

  • identity and access management;

  • privileged-user access;

  • encryption;

  • API security;

  • network security;

  • logging and audit trails;

  • cybersecurity monitoring;

  • backup;

  • disaster recovery;

  • business continuity;

  • personal-data protection;

  • client-data ownership; and

  • third-party access to Investia data.

    6. eKYC and AML Architecture

  • Advise on how external eKYC and AML providers should connect to the Investia platform.

    Define:

  • onboarding workflow;

  • identity-verification workflow;

  • sanctions and PEP screening;

  • handling of failed or referred applications;

  • ongoing AML monitoring;

  • storage of KYC status;

  • audit records; and

  • interfaces with the financial back office.

    7. Digital Subscription Process

    Design the technical workflow covering:

    Investor registration

  • eKYC/AML

  • product selection

  • disclosures

  • subscription instruction

  • payment confirmation

  • back-office processing

  • unit allocation

  • client confirmation

  • portfolio reporting

    The same architecture should support subsequent redemptions and additional subscriptions.

    8. Future Architecture

    The system should be designed from the beginning to accommodate future phases including:

  • IFP portfolio management;

  • public-market investing;

  • international portfolios;

  • robo-advisory;

  • AI investment assistance;

  • digital suitability/risk profiling;

  • white-label banking platforms;

  • additional fund managers;

  • sukuk products;

  • tokenisation where appropriate; and

  • additional financial service providers.

    Required Deliverables

    At completion of the assignment, the consultant will deliver:

    1. Current-state technology assessment
    2. Target architecture diagram
    3. Detailed systems architecture
    4. TEA Computers technical assessment
    5. Minimum TEA system requirements
    6. API architecture and integration map
    7. Data architecture
    8. Cybersecurity architecture
    9. Production/UAT/DR infrastructure requirements
    10. Cloud and database recommendations
    11. eKYC and AML integration architecture
    12. Digital subscription workflow
    13. Vendor responsibility matrix
    14. ICG internal technical-team responsibility matrix
    15. Technology implementation roadmap
    16. Phase 1 MVP specifications
    17. Phase 2 and future scalability plan
    18. Estimated technology budget and five-year cost framework

    The consultant should also provide sufficient documentation for Investia’s internal engineers to take over implementation.

Requirements

  • Required Qualifications

  • Candidates should have at least 10–15 years of relevant technology experience, with substantial senior-level responsibility.

  • Strong candidates will have experience in several of the following areas:

  • banking technology;

  • asset-management systems;

  • securities or brokerage systems;

  • fintech platforms;

  • digital wealth management;

  • fund administration;

  • financial-system APIs;

  • cloud architecture;

  • cybersecurity;

  • financial databases;

  • eKYC/AML integrations;

  • payment-system integrations.

  • Experience with Egyptian financial institutions or regulated non-bank financial activities is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of some of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • FRA technology requirements;

  • MCDR connectivity;

  • Egyptian banking infrastructure;

  • Oracle databases;

  • Oracle WebLogic;

  • Microsoft SQL Server;

  • REST APIs;

  • cloud platforms;

  • identity management;

  • information-security standards.

title: BOARD MEMBER/DIRECTOR
description:
Join the Board of Urras nan Tursachan and help shape the future of Calanais, contributing your skills, experience and perspective as we enter an exciting chapter for the organisation and the Visitor Centre.

ROLE Description

BOARD MEMBER

Urras nan Tursachan (The STANDING Stones Trust)


About Urras nan Tursachan

Calanais Visitor Centre is entering an exciting new chapter.

With the redeveloped Visitor Centre now open and operational, our focus is on establishing Calanais as a high-quality visitor attraction, a thriving and sustainable organisation, and an important asset for the local community.

Alongside providing an outstanding experience for visitors, Calanais has an important role as a local employer. We want to provide good-quality, year-round employment, create opportunities for people to develop and grow, and build an organisation that is well managed, financially sustainable and able to invest in its future.

As we move into this next phase, we are looking to strengthen our Board by welcoming new members who share our passion for Calanais and who are keen to contribute their skills, experience and perspective to help shape its future.


The Role

Board Members/Directors are responsible collectively for the strategic leadership and good governance of Urras nan Tursachan (The Calanais Stones Trust).

Working alongside fellow Board members and the Management Team, you will help ensure that the organisation is well run, financially responsible, sustainable and focused on achieving its long-term ambitions.

Board members are not expected to become involved in the day-to-day management of the organisation. Instead, their role is to provide strategic direction, oversight, support and constructive challenge, while using their individual skills and experience to add value where appropriate.

Key Responsibilities

As a Board Member, you will:

  • contribute actively to the strategic direction and future development of Calanais;
  • attend and participate in monthly Board meetings;
  • prepare for meetings by reading papers and considering key issues in advance;
  • contribute to effective governance, oversight and decision-making;
  • help ensure that Calanais is financially sustainable, well managed and appropriately governed;
  • provide constructive challenge and support to fellow Board members and the Management Team;
  • contribute your own skills, knowledge, experience and networks where these can benefit the organisation;
  • provide occasional ad hoc advice, support or involvement between Board meetings where appropriate;
  • act as a positive ambassador for Calanais;
  • support the organisation's commitment to providing good-quality, year-round local employment;
  • help ensure that the organisation remains connected to and responsive to the local community; and
  • act in the best interests of Calanais and support the collective decisions of the Board.


Our Priorities for the Next Chapter

The Board will play an important role in helping Calanais to:

  • establish the new Visitor Centre as a first-class visitor attraction;
  • deliver an excellent and distinctive visitor experience;
  • celebrate and protect the heritage, history and cultural significance of Calanais;
  • strengthen Calanais's role as an important community asset;
  • develop a financially sustainable and profitable organisation;
  • grow commercial and earned income;
  • provide good-quality, sustainable local employment throughout the year;
  • create a positive workplace where employees can develop and thrive;
  • strengthen partnerships; and
  • ensure that Calanais is well positioned for long-term growth and sustainability.


Requirements

Who We Are Looking For

We are interested in hearing from people who have a genuine passion for Calanais and would like to use their skills and experience to contribute to its future.


You do not need previous Board experience to be considered.






We are looking for people who:


  • care about Calanais and its importance to the islands;
  • understand, or are willing to develop an understanding of, the local community, culture and context;
  • can think strategically and contribute to the bigger picture;
  • are willing to ask constructive questions and offer considered challenge;
  • work collaboratively and respect different perspectives;
  • bring skills, experience, knowledge or networks that could help the organisation develop; and
  • can act with integrity, good judgement and in the best interests of Calanais.


We welcome a broad range of professional, voluntary, community and lived experience.


We are especially keen to speak to individuals who have a lived experience in any of these areas:


  • tourism and visitor attractions;
  • commercial/business development;
  • finance;
  • heritage and culture;
  • hospitality and retail;
  • fundraising and income generation;
  • people, HR and organisational development;
  • marketing and communications;
  • digital development;
  • community development;
  • Gaelic language and culture;
  • sustainability;
  • property and facilities;
  • education; and
  • governance and strategic leadership.


We also recognise the particular value of people who have strong knowledge of, or connections with, Lewis and the wider Outer Hebrides.


Time Commitment

Approximately 5–10 hours per month.

This will normally include:

  • attendance at a monthly Board meeting;
  • preparation and reading ahead of meetings; and
  • occasional ad hoc support, advice or participation in Board activity between meetings.


There may also be occasional strategy sessions, development meetings or events.

Term of Appointment

Four years, with the possibility of renewal.

Location

Board meetings will normally be held online.

Remuneration

This is a voluntary, unpaid position.

Reasonable expenses incurred in carrying out Board duties may be reimbursed in accordance with Calanais's expenses policy.



Benefits

What You Will Gain

Joining the Calanais Board offers an opportunity to:

  • help shape the future of one of the Outer Hebrides' most significant heritage and visitor attractions;
  • contribute directly to the economic and community impact of Calanais;
  • help support high-quality local employment;
  • use your professional and personal experience in a meaningful way;
  • work alongside people with a shared commitment to Calanais;
  • develop your own governance, strategic and leadership experience; and
  • play a part in an exciting period of organisational growth and development.


Most Importantly

We are looking for people who want to make a difference.

You do not need to be an expert in every aspect of running a visitor attraction or organisation. A strong Board is made up of people with different skills, experiences and perspectives who work well together.

If you are passionate about Calanais, interested in its future and believe you have something to contribute, we would be delighted to hear from you.



How to Apply

If you are interested in joining the Calanais Board, we would love to hear from you.

Please send us a short Expression of Interest statement telling us why you would like to become a Board Member, what interests you about the future of Calanais, and the skills, experience, knowledge or connections you believe you could bring to the Board. This does not need to be a formal application – we are keen to hear about professional, community, voluntary and lived experience that you feel would help you make a positive contribution.


Please send your Expression of Interest to Claire Smith, Orbit Agency: claire@orbit.agency by 9th October 2026.

title: Solicitor - Family Law

About the Role

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in the team, managing a caseload focusing primarily on children matters, whilst providing exceptional service to clients. title: Senior FullStack Software Engineer
description:
Company Description

Beem is a Pan-African startup with a presence across more than 25 African markets. We envision an Africa powered by enterprises, empowered through technology. Our mission is to enable enterprises to create lasting relationships with customers across Africa using SMS, USSD, airtime & chat through our products. Read more about our story at.

Position Summary

We're looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Fullstack Software Engineer to join our team and help shape the future of cloud communication services across Africa.


You won't just write code, you will own features from ideation to deployment, architect scalable systems, and mentor fellow engineers. You’ll work across the full stack, crafting responsive UIs, designing high-throughput services, and deploying on AWS EKS using DevOps best practices

If you thrive in ambiguity, love solving complex problems, and want to build infrastructure that powers enterprise and startup communication across an entire continent, we'd like to meet you!


Culture, Career Growth and Development

At Beem, our most valuable resource is our people. We're serious about our work, but embrace fun and flexibility to get the job done. We believe that employee satisfaction starts with creating a supportive and inclusive environment where employees feel welcome no matter their personal or professional backgrounds. We’ve developed a unique culture of constant learning and are investing in developing our people. Through regular feedback on your performance and monthly reviews, you get an opportunity to discuss your challenges, aspirations, career goals and continuously keep growing in a fast-paced organization thus building a rewarding long-term career with Beem


Work Mode : Full time, on-site


WHAT YOU WILL DO ON A DAILY BASIS

This is what your day-to-day will actually look like as a Senior Fullstack Engineer at Beem:

  • Lead technical discovery & architecture: Partner with Product Managers to translate complex business requirements into scalable, event-driven microservices. Define service boundaries, data models, and API contracts before writing production code. Draft technical documentations.

  • Build across the full stack: Develop robust backend services using Node.js and TypeScript, and build intuitive, performant user interfaces using React and Next.js (SSR, SSG, ISR, App Router). Own features end-to-end.

  • Own the deployment pipeline: Deploy services to Amazon EKS, manage infrastructure-as-code, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, and ArgoCD (GitOps). Ensure zero-downtime rollouts and quick rollbacks.

  • Drive quality at every layer: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using Playwright, Jest, Mocha, Vitest, or Cypress. Ensure our APIs and UI work flawlessly across diverse African network conditions.

  • Master the data layer: Write complex SQL queries, optimize stored procedures, design efficient schemas, and tune database performance for high-throughput production environments across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and NoSQL databases like MongoDB.

  • Collaborate with telcos & vendors: Interface directly with mobile operators across Africa to troubleshoot integrations, optimize SMS/USSD delivery, and ensure high availability.

  • Mentor & level up the team: Review pull requests, pair programs with junior engineers, and promote best practices around code quality, type safety, security, and performance.

  • Document & share knowledge: Write clear technical documentation, API specs, and runbooks so that the entire team benefits from your expertise.

  • Participate in on-call rotation: Help ensure 99.9% uptime for our enterprise customers by responding to production incidents and driving root-cause analysis.



Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

1. EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred, but not mandatory.
  • Minimum 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years in a senior/lead capacity.
  • Candidates without a degree should have 7+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Strong portfolio, GitHub contributions, open-source work, and proven experience delivering production-grade software are highly valued.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively within a distributed, cross-functional team.

2. MANDATORY TECHNICAL HARD SKILLS

Software Architecture & Design

  • Proven ability to design scalable, maintainable, fault-tolerant systems, define service boundaries, make technical trade-offs, and create technical documentation.

Backend Development

  • Strong experience with JavaScript (Node.js) and/or TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, performance optimization, and scalable backend systems.
  • Experience with:
    • RESTful APIs and complex business logic.
    • Authentication/authorization: JWT, OAuth2, API keys.
    • Third-party, telco, and vendor API integrations.
    • RabbitMQ and event-driven architectures.
    • Webhooks/callbacks, including security, idempotency, retries, and monitoring.
    • Background workers, job queues, and long-running operations.
    • SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB), including schema design, indexing, query optimization, stored procedures, triggers, functions, and migrations.
    • Performance, reliability, and security patterns such as rate limiting, circuit breakers, bulkheads, and graceful degradation.
    • Middleware, error handling, structured logging, and observability.

description:
About PSC Biotech


Who are we?

PSC Biotech is a leading Biotech Consultancy firm founded in 1996, headquartered in Pomona, California, USA, with Global operations in Ireland, India, Singapore, Australia and the US, serving 350 clients in more than 23 countries worldwide. We provide cloud-based software solutions for Quality Management and Regulatory Inspections, pharmaceuticals contract manufacturing professionals, and metrology services to our clients.

We believe in creating high performing teams that can exceed our client’s expectations with regards to quality of all scalable and business unit deliverables, staying under budget and ensuring timelines for our deliverables are being met.


Summary:

The QRM lead is responsible for redefining and embedding a risk-based quality management approach for a new, digitally enabled biologics manufacturing facility. The role ensures that quality risk management is systematically applied across processes, systems, and operations, with particular focus on operational resiliency, digital system dependency, and paperless manufacturing continuity.




Requirements

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Design and implement a modern, facility-wide Quality Risk Management (QRM) framework, aligned with ICH Q9(R1), supporting a fully digital plant.
  • Embed risk-based thinking into all aspects of facility startup, including manufacturing processes, digital systems, automation, data flows, and quality oversight.
  • Assess and manage risks related to dependency on digital and corporate systems, including DCS, MES, eBR, ERP, data historians, and network infrastructure.
  • Define and govern business continuity and contingency strategies to ensure GMP compliance during system outages (e.g., network failures, cloud unavailability), including controlled fallback for paperless operations.
  • Partner with Quality, Manufacturing, IT, Automation, and Engineering to ensure risks are proactively identified, mitigated, and owned.
  • Ensure risk decisions are science-based, documented, and inspection-ready, supporting regulatory confidence in a highly digital operating model.


Education and experience:

  • Extensive experience in Quality Risk Management within GMP-regulated pharma or biologics manufacturing.
  • Strong knowledge of ICH Q9, digital manufacturing concepts, and system-enabled operations.
  • Proven ability to operate at a strategic level, influencing site design, operating models, and quality governance.
  • Experience addressing operational resiliency, data integrity, and business continuity in digital or paperless environments.

Location\: Chibougamau (Office) 533 Rte QC-167 S, Chibougamau, QC, G8P 2Y6

As a Core Shack Technician, you’ll be at the heart of our exploration efforts. Your days will include receiving and processing drill core, preparing samples for assay, and maintaining a clean and organized core shack. There is also the possibility to assist with fieldwork, including mapping and prospecting, operating vehicles safely, and helping geologists with various tasks as needed.

Safety is a shared responsibility, and we take it seriously. You’ll follow IAMGOLD’s safety protocols, use proper PPE, and contribute to a strong safety culture by reporting hazards and participating in regular safety meetings.

This role is ideal for individuals who are eager to learn and can adapt to changing priorities. You’ll be part of a team that values clear communication, mutual respect, and a strong work ethic. Life at Work

This role offers flexibility and is well-suited to both local and remote candidates. Individuals residing in Chibougamau, Chapais, or Oujé-Bougoumou will enjoy a consistent 5/2 schedule, commuting daily from their home communities. For those coming from Waswanipi or other remote areas, rotational schedules and comfortable camp accommodation are available to support their participation in exploration activities. No matter where you're based, you'll be part of a dynamic and supportive team, contributing to exciting projects across Quebec and gaining valuable experience in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

About IAMGOLD

In Canada, we operate the large-scale Côté Gold Mine in northern Ontario and the high-grade underground Westwood Gold Mine in Quebec — positioning us as one of the country’s leading gold producers. Additionally, we are advancing the Nelligan and Monster Lake camp which is among the largest gold camps in Canada. Internationally, we have been operating the Essakane Gold Mine in Burkina Faso for approx. 15 years.

With the expertise and dedication of approximately 3,700 employees worldwide, we are united by a common purpose\: to redefine mining. Driven by innovation and accountability, we create lasting value for our people, partners, and communities while operating responsibly and sustainably.

Guided by our core values, we put safety, respect for the environment, and people first. We are building a company that is future-focused, resilient, and proud of both its global heritage and Canadian roots.

What’s in it for you!

This role is more than just a technical position, it’s an opportunity to be part of a close-knit team that values collaboration, growth, and shared success. Within IAMGOLD’s exploration group, you’ll find a supportive environment that feels like family, where your contributions are recognized, and your growth is encouraged. It’s a chance to build meaningful relationships, expand your skillset, and make a lasting impact in a fast-paced and rewarding field.

IAMGOLD believes in rewarding outstanding performance with an equally outstanding total rewards package.

If you’re ready to take initiative, lead teams, and make a meaningful impact in the field, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Líder Técnico de Diseño
description:
This Opportunity

Provides technical tower detailing, drafting and CADD support, guidance, and oversight to ensure the production of high-quality engineering designs and specifications for high-voltage transmission line, lattice steel tower, and utility infrastructure projects. Responsibilities include overseeing and generating detailed lattice tower structural models, fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, erection drawings, member detailing, connection detailing, bolt schedules, material bundle lists, and bill of material (BOM) packages for complex, multi-site transmission projects of moderate to large scale and complexity. Generates and validates accurate and concise design-phase deliverables, steel detailing packages, 2D and/or 3D CADD layouts, fabrication specifications, construction packages, and as-built documentation. Coordinates closely with transmission line engineers, structural engineers, and steel fabricators to ensure constructability, manufacturability, and compliance with applicable standards, including ASCE, AISC, NESC, and utility-specific design requirements. Ensures all deliverables meet or exceed industry standards for transmission line engineering, lattice tower design, structural accuracy, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), drafting excellence, safety, constructability, and functionality.

Your Impact

· Collect, compile, and analyze data from, as-built drawings, structure loading analyses, engineering calculations, and technical specifications to support overhead transmission line, tower design, and utility infrastructure projects.

· Utilize 2D and 3D CADD software, including, AutoCAD, MicroStation, Bocad, and ProjectWise, while collaborating with engineers to resolve design discrepancies and prepare detailed, fabrication and construction packages for projects of moderate complexity and scope.

· Apply industry standards and engineering principles to provide technical design support while ensuring proper fit, form, function, fabrication, constructability, maintainability, clearance requirements, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and material quantity calculations in accordance with NESC, IEEE, utility, and client design standards.

· Serve as a technical resource regarding project progress, tower drafting methodologies, and problem resolution; may function as the primary Tower Detailing Specialist on projects or assist in coordinating drafting and design activities across multidisciplinary project teams.

· Verify the accuracy of detailing of lattice tower members and connections in conjunction with structure loading information, foundation layouts, design revisions, change orders, and engineering specifications while identifying and resolving design conflicts, constructability concerns, and technical issues associated with steel lattice towers.

· Work independently or as part of a cross-functional team consisting of transmission line engineers, structural engineers, foundation engineers, project managers, and steel fabricators, while occasionally leading technical assignments involving transmission structure detailing and drafting.

· Ensure designs comply with applicable local, state, federal, utility, FERC, NERC, and environmental regulations, as well as client-specific standards and permitting requirements.

· Develop and maintain multiple design alternatives and detailing solutions for review, including member orientation, member connections configurations, fabrication limitations, splice configuration, foundation connections, and constructability evaluations.

· Monitor and oversee tower detailing, drafting, fabrication packages, erection plans, steel shop drawings, and QA/QC reviews to ensure quality control, constructability, and contract compliance while documenting project progress and technical issues.

· Collaborate closely with the engineer-of-record, engineer-in-charge, structural engineers, transmission line engineers, and other technical professionals during project phases, design reviews, constructability assessments, and quality checks.

· Apply advanced analytical techniques and software tools to solve complex transmission structure and drafting challenges, modify existing tower designs, support tower upgrades, line rebuilds, reconductoring efforts, and asset replacement projects, and ensure compliance with project specifications.

· Interface periodically with utility clients, contractors, steel fabricators, and construction personnel to coordinate transmission structure detailing, fabrication schedules, and design support activities.

· Participate in pre-construction meetings, fabrication reviews, constructability workshops, and field support discussions to address questions regarding tower drawings, steel member layouts, connection details, and construction sequencing.

· Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior designers and drafting personnel on Auto-CADD modeling, Bocad modeling, drawing standards, tower drafting practices, transmission line design principles, and QA/QC procedures.

· Maintain current knowledge of tower detailing practices, transmission line engineering practices, utility standards, NESC requirements, emerging technologies, BIM workflows, digital delivery methods, and drafting/design software advancements.

· Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company resources while adhering to WSP's Code of Conduct, safety requirements, quality standards, and project delivery expectations.

· Perform additional responsibilities as required to support transmission line, substation interconnection, utility modernization, grid resiliency, and power delivery projects.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

· High School Diploma.

· Minimum of 11 years of relevant post education experience in discipline with prior drafting and design support experience.

· Advanced knowledge of drafting and design support principles, practices, process, methods and techniques.

· Advanced knowledge of relevant codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.

· Strong ability to make technical computations and calculations involving the application of geometry and mathematical concepts, understanding plans and specifications, and making factual comparisons to the appropriate standards or regulations.

· Analytical mindset with an ability to exercise sound judgement in evaluating situations and making decisions.

· Strong interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to a technical and non-technical audience.

· Highly proficient self-leadership with attention to detail, results orientation, and managing multiple priorities in a dynamic work environment.

· Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, follow instruction, work independently, and comply with company policies.

· Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, software, technology, math principles, spreadsheets, and tools.

· Competent critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to apply technical knowledge to reach conclusions from data collation, calculations, statistical analysis and arriving at the most effective and logical solution.

· Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

· Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.

· Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor’s Degree in closely related discipline is preferred.

Disclaimer

· Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

title: Senior Implementation Analyst
description:
Role Overview

The Senior Implementation Analyst (SIA) plays a pivotal role in the end-to-end delivery of software products across client engagements. The SIA owns the structured implementation of assigned projects — from initiation and planning through to UAT, Go Live, and formal closure.

Working in close coordination with the Project Manager and cross-functional teams, the SIA brings deep functional expertise, disciplined execution, and strong client engagement to every implementation. The SIA serves as the primary functional point of contact for the client during the implementation lifecycle — ensuring that the product is configured, trained, and adopted in a manner that delivers measurable value to the client's business.


Roles & Responsibilities

1. Project Planning & Execution

o Develop and own the Implementation Plan for each assigned engagement / project— covering scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and deliverable schedules.

o Translate signed contracts, Purchase Orders (POs), and client briefs into structured implementation charters, clearly defining scope of work, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.

o Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records on the project management system (Zoho Projects or equivalent) at all times — including implementation plans, milestone trackers, action items, defect trackers, risks, and project documentation.

o Proactively identify implementation risks and escalate them in a timely manner — maintaining a risk register and applying structured mitigation approaches in line with best practices.

o Ensure that every project is tracked not just against timelines and scope, but against the client's actual business objectives — consistently measuring whether the implementation is delivering the value committed at the point of sale.


2. Functional Delivery & Product Expertise

o Gain deep functional mastery of all assigned products and serve as the go-to functional expert for clients, internal teams, and project stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.

o Collaborate with clients and concerned stakeholder(s) to understand their goals, workflows, and implementation vision — and translate these into a structured, feasible delivery plan.

o Conduct functional training sessions for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Go Live — ensuring that end users are fully equipped to adopt the product effectively.

o Provide best practice usage advisory to clients, recommending optimal configurations and usage approaches based on client context and product capabilities.

o Prepare project-specific training documentation, user guides, and functional reference materials tailored to the client's environment and user base.

o Interface with internal teams to resolve functional gaps, technical dependencies, or product-related challenges that arise during implementation.


3. Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management

o Serve as the primary functional point of contact for the client during the implementation — building trust, managing expectations, and maintaining a high standard of client communication throughout.

o Conduct regular structured check-ins and progress reviews with client stakeholders — proactively communicating status, risks, decisions required, and next steps.

o Manage client concerns, escalations, and change requests in a composed and solutions-oriented manner — coordinating internally to resolve issues without compromising delivery timelines.

o Liaise with the concerned team to ensure a smooth post-implementation handover and sustained client satisfaction after Go Live.

o Represent the company professionally in client interactions at all levels — reinforcing the organization’s commitment to delivery excellence and client delight.


4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

o Work closely with the assigned Project Manager to align on project priorities, share status updates, flag dependencies, and escalate risks within agreed protocols.

o Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth and timely delivery of services to the client.

o Serve as liaison between technical and non-technical teams, both within the organization and at client and vendor / subcontractor organizations, to ensure all project targets and requirements are met.

o Contribute structured, data-backed feedback on client observations, recurring implementation challenges, and product gaps to the Project Manager and SBU leadership.


5. Process, Governance & Administration

o Adhere to all implementation processes, documentation standards, and governance protocols as defined by the function — including Ideal Implementation Plans (IIPs), Implementation Risks & Pre-Requisites Documentation (IRPD), and Risk Assessment & Risk Treatment Registers (RART).

o Ensure complete, accurate, and timely updation of all project management system entries for every assigned implementation — providing real-time visibility to the Project Manager and leadership.

o Participate actively in implementation retrospectives — sharing learnings, contributing to process improvement discussions, and adopting refined methodologies in subsequent engagements.

o Ensure compliance with all central company policies, including Travel Policy, Information Security (INFOSEC) Policy, and any other applicable guidelines.



Requirements

Qualification / Skill-sets

  • B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA / MBA or equivalent Technical Graduate / Post-Graduate with a sound understanding of software solutions and their implementation.
  • 3 – 5 years of experience in a Software Implementation, or Project Delivery role within a software product or technology environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage end-to-end software implementation projects — from initiation and planning through to UAT, Go Live, and closure.
  • Strong command of project management concepts and methodologies — with working knowledge of both Agile (Scrum / Kanban) and Waterfall approaches.
  • Proficiency in project management tools (Zoho Projects, Jira, MS Project, or equivalent) — with the ability to maintain structured implementation records and generate meaningful reports.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills — with the ability to engage confidently with client stakeholders at all levels, including senior management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — ability to identify root causes, structure solutions, and make sound recommendations under pressure and in complex multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Sound interpersonal skills — with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams, manage client relationships, and navigate conflict professionally.
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to travel (within the city as well as PAN India) for client meetings, implementations, training sessions, and Go Live support.


Added Advantage Qualification / Skill-sets

  • Prior experience in a BFSI-domain software company, with working knowledge of banking regulations, compliance frameworks, or financial technology products.
  • Basic to working knowledge of SQL or Oracle databases — ability to independently validate data and query implementation-relevant information without technical support.
  • Exposure to ISO, CMM, or Six Sigma quality frameworks — with experience applying structured quality practices in a software delivery context.
  • PMP Certification (preferred): Candidates who hold a valid PMP certification from PMI are preferred. Candidates without the certification are expected to demonstrate a clear inclination and intent to pursue PMP as part of their professional development.
  • Experience in managing vendor or subcontractor deliverables as part of a structured implementation.
  • Familiarity with product development lifecycle concepts — from product requirements and design through to testing, release, and implementation.


Note: This job profile is indicative and maybe updated from time to time based on organizational requirements. Any other roles and responsibilities as suggested by the SBU Head / Deputy Head shall also form part of this profile.

title: Global Internship Program (GIP) – Full-Stack Pathway
description:
Begin the Application:

Click here to register for the coding challenge (no time limit).

--------

We're moving!

HENNGE is tentatively scheduled to relocate our Tokyo headquarters from Shibuya to Shinjuku in April 2027. All the batches opened for application will take place at our brand-new Shinjuku office.

--------

About the Program

HENNGE’s Global Internship Program (GIP) is an on-site software engineering training program designed and run by HENNGE, a cloud security company based in Tokyo. The program is created for students and early-career engineers who want to strengthen their full-stack engineering skills in a global, English-speaking environment at our Tokyo headquarters.

This Full-Stack Pathway focuses on hands-on application development training across back-end, front-end, and basic DevOps, using Python (non-ML stack), Go, or TypeScript on the back-end and TypeScript with modern front-end frameworks on the front-end. The program emphasizes fundamental engineering skills, problem-solving, explanation, and collaboration, rather than production work.

Internship Schedule

  • Batch 2 (2027): Jun 1 - Jul 16 (7 weeks)

  • Batch 3 (2027): Aug 2 - Sep 3 (5 weeks)

  • Batch 4 (2027): Oct 1 - Oct 29 (5 weeks)

What You’ll Learn & Practice

During the program, you will:

  • Develop full-stack web applications as part of structured training projects

  • Build and connect back-end APIs and services with front-end applications

  • Practice key full-stack engineering concepts, including:

    • Back-end logic and API design

    • Front-end state management and data flow

    • Authentication and security basics

    • Software testing (unit, integration, end-to-end)

  • Learn, at a practical level, how front-end, back-end, and cloud infrastructure interact

  • Work with Unix-like environments and basic DevOps tooling

  • Explain your technical decisions, trade-offs, and problem-solving approach during discussions and reviews

  • Receive feedback from mentors and iteratively improve your implementation.

Program Structure

  • Monday to Friday, 10:00-19:00 JST

  • Weeks 1-4: Full-Stack Application Development Project

  • Week 5: DevOps & Infrastructure Project

  • Weeks 6-7 (conditional): Special Assignment - a unique project for each intern and specific to their batch.

Benefits

  • Round-trip airfares from and back to your country of residence

  • Pre-arrival support and visa guidance

  • Medical insurance* and a phone with mobile data will be provided during your internship in Tokyo, Japan**

  • Up to 150,000 JPY of monthly subsidy to cover accommodation, meals, transportation, and networking activities

  • Subsidized company events on top of monthly subsidy (Monthly Technical Sessions, Board Game Night, Get-to-know-you Lunches, and many others!) to get to know teams across divisions

  • Access to online learning platform during the internship period

* Medical insurance will only be provided to interns who do not reside in Japan

** This internship is an unpaid training program with a subsidy provided to all interns

Our Stance on AI and Software Engineering

AI tools can be helpful, but the goal of HENNGE’s Global Internship Program (GIP) is to help you build strong software engineering fundamentals.

To support that learning, we ask you not to use AI tools to generate code for training assignments or solution implementations. The code you submit should be written by you and reflect your own understanding.

You may use a designated AI service to support your learning in non-code-generating ways, such as clarifying technical concepts, understanding documentation, or helping with non-essential tasks (for example, command-line options).

Throughout the program, you’ll be expected to take ownership of your code and clearly explain your thinking, trade-offs, and design decisions. In this learning environment, you are the engineer and the final gatekeeper of quality

Notice for Applicants

  • A limited number of internship slots are available. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and positions will be filled on a first-come, first-served basis. We encourage you to apply early, as applications will close once all positions are filled.

  • The coding challenge has no time limit, and the screening process will not consider solving time. Please note that the application is completed after uploading application documents and filling in the batch preferences.

  • Please take another challenge if you are (also) interested in applying for HENNGE’s GIP Front-end Engineering Pathway. Please use different emails to sign up if you apply for both internships.

Requirements

Essential Qualifications

  • Third-year undergraduate or higher (including Master's and Doctoral students). Recent graduates are welcome to apply

  • Pursuing or holding a degree in Computer Science or a related field. If not, equivalent experience from a tech internship or bootcamp is expected

  • Fluency in English (Japanese not required)

  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or React/Vue in TypeScript

  • Knowledge of Linux / MacOS / Unix-like environments

  • Interested in open source or tech community activities

  • Interested in pursuing a career in Japan

At least meet three of the following:

  • Experience in cloud computing platforms, especially AWS

  • Experience in full stack web application development

  • Knowledge of distributed systems

  • Knowledge of DevOps tools and practices (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code)

  • Knowledge of Container technology (e.g. Docker)

More details about the technology stack for this internship program can be found on the HENNGE website.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal full stack engineering intern is a curious problem-solver who’s excited to build real-world applications and grow in a fast-paced tech environment. We’re especially interested in candidates who:

  • Are proficient in Python, Go, and React/Vue in TypeScript

  • Are comfortable working in Unix-like environments

  • Have a solid grasp of both front-end and back-end development

  • Have an interest in cloud computing and DevOps practices

  • Are passionate about learning, contributing to tech communities, and possibly pursuing a career in Japan

Bring your curiosity, versatility, and drive—we’re excited to see what you can build with us.

However, AI should enhance your engineering ability — not replace it.

You must be able to understand the code you submit, identify incorrect or insecure AI-generated implementations, debug problems independently and explain the technical decisions behind your work.

Experience integrating LLM APIs, AI agents, structured outputs, tool/function calling, RAG or AI-powered automation is a strong advantage.


Remote Working

You will be expected to maintain reliable availability during agreed working hours, attend scheduled online meetings, provide regular progress updates and communicate blockers promptly.

We value quality, ownership, communication and measurable delivery rather than simply being online.

Selection Process

You may use AI development tools during the assessment. We are interested in how effectively you use them, but you must understand and be able to explain everything you submit.

Successful candidates will then attend a technical interview focused primarily on their implementation, engineering decisions and previous real-world development experience.

Requirements

  • REST API design and development

  • Authentication and authorisation

  • Role-based access control

  • Input validation and error handling

  • Third-party API integrations

Databases

  • PostgreSQL and/or MySQL

  • MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases

  • Database and schema design

  • Data modelling and relationships

  • SQL

  • Indexing and query optimisation

Experience with Prisma or another modern ORM is desirable.


Engineering Fundamentals

You should have a practical understanding of:

  • Clean and maintainable code

  • Modular software design

  • Git and GitHub

  • Debugging and testing

  • Code reviews

  • Application architecture

  • API and database security

  • Authentication and authorisation

  • Data isolation

  • Performance and scalability

  • Secure handling of application secrets and user data

You do not need to be a senior software architect, but you should be able to make sensible technical decisions and explain the trade-offs behind them.


AI Development Skills

You should be comfortable using modern AI development tools such as:

  • Claude Code

  • Codex

  • GitHub Copilot

  • Similar AI coding assistants

Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into real applications is highly desirable.


Cloud & Deployment

Experience with some of the following is desirable:

  • AWS

  • Vercel

  • Supabase

  • Firebase

  • Docker

  • CI/CD

  • Linux

  • Cloud databases

Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has built real applications beyond tutorials and coursework.

  • Can show examples of projects they personally contributed to.

  • Can take ownership of a feature from requirement to production.

  • Can work independently without requiring detailed instructions for every task.

  • Has strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Application Requirements

The ideal candidate will have the following experience / skills:

title: Non-Revenue Water (NRW) Project Manager
description:

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
description:

Hours\: 37.5 hours per week
Faculty/Department\: Information Technology Services
Campus/Location\: North Campus – must be comfortable working hybrid, a minimum of four (4) days on-site.
Starting Salary Range\: $120,232 - $134,806; starting salaries are determined based on qualifications and years of related experience. *

About the Information Technology Services at Humber\:
Humber Digital Innovation, Information Technology Services provides leadership for the continuous development of digital experiences delivered on a secure, flexible, and dependable IT environment built on a foundation of transparency, collaboration, client focus, and respect. Together we transform client ideas into results, leverage technology to enable student engagement and success, support students and employees in the journey of discovery, deliver integrated digital solutions to improve collaboration and communication across the Humber community, and improve business processes to enable better decision-making. Digital Innovation, Information Technology Services is always striving to enhance the digital experience for students, staff, and visitors.

About the Portfolio Product Owner - Enterprise Architect Role\:
Under the general direction of the Associate Vice President, Information Technology Services, the Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining and evolving Humber’s enterprise technology strategy, ensuring alignment between institutional priorities, digital initiatives, and the overall technology landscape. You will provide strategic direction across platforms, products, and integrations, guiding enterprise level decisions that shape Humber’s digital future. Working closely with senior leadership, Product Owners, and Architects, you will ensure that technology investments are intentional, scalable, and aligned with long term institutional outcomes. You will play a key role in evaluating emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence, and determining their applicability within Humber’s academic and administrative environment. Ultimately, you are accountable for ensuring that Humber’s technology ecosystem is cohesive, future ready, and capable of supporting innovation at scale.

How You Work Within Humber’s Product and Architecture Model

Humber operates within a product management model supported by a layered architecture approach. As the Enterprise Architect, you operate at the institutional level, ensuring alignment between strategic goals, business priorities, product delivery, and technology roadmaps, while driving the identification, assessment, and mitigation of digital risk across the institution.

You will partner with senior leadership to shape enterprise solutions and define product and technology roadmaps, ensuring alignment with institutional priorities, regulatory requirements, and long-term strategic direction. You will also collaborate with Legal, Risk, and Privacy teams to assess and manage digital risk, ensuring that architectural decisions support secure, compliant, and responsible use of technology.

In this role, you provide direction and alignment across the product and architecture ecosystem\:

  • Business Product Owners (BPOs)\: who are responsible for defining business value, client needs, and desired outcomes. You provide strategic direction to ensure these outcomes are supported by scalable, sustainable, and enterprise-aligned capabilities.

  • Technology Product Owners (TPOs)\: who are responsible for delivery execution, backlog management, and platform integrity. You guide and govern architectural direction to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.

  • Applications and Solution Architects\: who design and implement platform-specific solutions. You establish architectural standards, provide decision frameworks, and ensure consistency across all implementations within the enterprise landscape.

In this model, you are accountable for setting up enterprise architectural direction, enabling informed decision-making, and ensuring that all product and platform-level work contribute to a cohesive, scalable, risk-aware, and future-ready digital ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the enterprise architecture roadmap, ensuring alignment with Humber’s strategic goals, institutional priorities and digital transformation goals.

  • Establish and maintain enterprise level technology roadmaps that guide platform evolution, integration, and modernization across the institution.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the AVP, ITS and senior leadership, contributing to executive level decision making on technology direction and investment.

  • Provide enterprise level architectural direction and decision frameworks that guide technology investments and solution design across the institution.

  • Ensure technology investments and platform decisions are aligned with enterprise priorities, maximizing value, long term sustainability, scalability, and resilience of the enterprise technology landscape.

  • Lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, assessing their impact, value, and risk within the institutional context.

  • Ensure alignment and coherence across the enterprise technology landscape, including academic systems, administrative platforms, CRM, identity, data, and integration layers.

  • Direct and govern architectural decisions across product teams, ensuring consistency with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.

  • Establish and enforce enterprise architecture governance, standards, and best practices across all technology domains.

  • Identify, assess, and communicate enterprise level risks related to technology, architecture, data, and security, enabling informed decision making at the leadership level.

  • Drive cross-portfolio alignment by working with senior leadership, Product Owners, Architects, and technical leaders to manage dependencies and ensure cohesive solution design.

  • Participate in and contribute to enterprise governance forums, both internally and externally, providing architectural insight and recommendations for strategic initiatives, including engagement with communities such as EDUCAUSE, ITANA, and other relevant higher education and enterprise architecture networks.

  • Translate complex architectural concepts into clear, outcome focused communication for executive audiences.

title: Core IRIS / T24 Developer
description:

You will collaborate with business analysts, other IT teams, and delivery leads to translate banking requirements into robust technical solutions, while maintaining production stability and security.

  • Design, develop, and maintain customizations and interfaces in Temenos T24 (Transact).

  • Work across core-banking modules such as AA, FT, AC, LD, MM, LC, LG, and customer-management capabilities.

  • Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot T24 routines including Enquiries, Versions, OFS, TM, and browser customizations.

  • Develop and support web services using IRIS, OFS integration, SOAP APIs, and interfaces with third-party systems.

  • Lead or participate in T24 upgrade, patching, enhancement, and release activities, assessing technical impact and supporting controlled rollout.

  • Collaborate with business analysts and other IT teams to translate functional banking requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Troubleshoot complex T24 application, integration, data, and environment issues and coordinate resolution across dependent teams.

  • Contribute to DevOps and CI/CD practices in a T24 context where applicable, including repeatable deployment and environment discipline.

  • Maintain technical documentation covering routines, interfaces, dependencies, release changes, and support considerations.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on Temenos T24 development experience.

  • Strong practical experience with jBASE, InfoBasic, and the T24 Toolkit.

  • Deep understanding of T24 architecture and core modules including AA, AC, FT, LD, MM, and related banking capabilities.

  • Experience with TAFJ environments and T24 release upgrades.

  • Experience developing IRIS web services, OFS integrations, SOAP APIs, and third-party interfaces.

  • Practical experience supporting SIT, UAT, production rollout, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

Required Skills

  • Temenos T24 / Transact

  • jBASE and InfoBasic

  • T24 Toolkit

  • AA, AC, FT, LD, MM and related core modules

  • TAFJ

  • IRIS web services

  • OFS integration and SOAP APIs

  • T24 browser / UI customization

  • T24 debugging and performance tuning

  • DevOps / CI/CD concepts in a T24 environment

Banking / Fintech & Nice to Have

  • Strong banking-domain knowledge is highly valuable for this role and practical understanding of banking business processes and compliance expectations is expected.

  • Experience with LC, LG, customer management, and broader core-banking integration scenarios.

  • Experience leading technical workstreams for upgrades, patches, or complex enhancements.

  • Exposure to modern API management and digital-channel integration around core banking.

title: Civil Engineering-in-Training
description:
What if you could redefine what's possible? With us, you can.

You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity. People who get it.

We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers.

With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science‑based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions.

We are pathfinders and impact makers.

We are Visioneers.

We are WSP.

The Opportunity

Build the Future with Us

Help shape the communities where people live, work, and thrive. As a Civil Engineering-in-Training, you will contribute to the planning, design, and delivery of municipal infrastructure projects including roadways, water distribution systems, sanitary sewers, stormwater management facilities, and land development projects. This role offers a balance of technical design and field review responsibilities, providing valuable experience across the full project lifecycle while working alongside industry-leading professionals.

Your Impact

· Prepare detailed engineering drawings, plans, profiles, and construction documents using AutoCAD Civil 3D for municipal infrastructure projects.

· Perform hydraulic, stormwater management, grading, and earthwork calculations to support project design and delivery.

· Assist in the preparation of engineering reports, technical memoranda, and permit applications for municipal and regulatory approvals.

· Collaborate with project managers, clients, contractors, and senior engineers to advance projects from concept through construction.

· Conduct field reviews and site inspections to verify construction compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and applicable standards.

· Document site progress, observations, and deficiencies through detailed field reports and photographic records.

· Witness and record quality assurance testing activities, including soil compaction, concrete testing, and other construction verification processes.

· Support the development of sustainable and resilient infrastructure that positively impacts local communities and future generations.

The Skills That Set You Apart

· Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited institution

· Experience with or strong proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D and Microsoft Office applications.

· Knowledge of municipal engineering design principles including grading, stormwater management, water distribution, and sanitary systems.

· Familiarity with hydraulic and stormwater modeling software is considered an asset.

· Strong technical writing skills with the ability to prepare clear and concise engineering reports and field review documentation.

· Effective communication and coordination skills for working with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and contractors.

  • French language is an asset.
  • English language proficiency (written and spoken)

Why Choose WSP?

We exist to shape communities to advance humanity. The brightest engineers, advisors and scientists from across the globe call WSP home.

• Proudly Canadian – we are a Top 100 Employer in Canada for 2026.
• A global community of brilliant minds – your next idea, mentor, or opportunity is always within reach.
• Limitless opportunities start here. Whether it’s across the country or around the globe, we help you tailor your role to match your ambition — because your growth drives ours.
• Flexible work, real balance – we recognize the importance of balance in our lives and encourage you to prioritize the balance in yours.

#WeAreWSP

Ready to Shape the Future?

Bring your curiosity, technical expertise, and passion for municipal infrastructure to a team that is helping build stronger, safer, and more sustainable communities. If you're ready to gain hands-on experience, work on impactful projects, and grow your engineering career alongside industry leaders, we'd love to hear from you. Join WSP and help create what's next.

title: Senior Sourcing Lead
description:
We are IAMGOLD. Innovative, Accountable Mining.

IAMGOLD is a Canadian-based gold mining company with operations and development projects across North America and West Africa. With flagship operations such as the Côté Gold Mine in Ontario—one of Canada’s largest and most technologically advanced gold mines—we’re not just mining gold; we’re shaping the future of mining.

We believe mining can be different. By combining innovation with a strong commitment to sustainability and accountability, we create lasting value for our people and the communities where we operate. At IAMGOLD, when we engage, empower, and support each other, we create extraordinary outcomes—delivering value for our people, partners, and stakeholders while building stronger, more resilient communities.

At Côté Gold, we’re leading the way in modern mining. With an 18+ year mine life, Côté Gold will inject C$5 billion in wages into the economy and create lasting benefits for the region. Over 600 full-time jobs and strong partnerships with Mattagami and Flying Post First Nations mean you’ll be part of something bigger—building prosperity and progress for generations. Industry leaders call us “a model for modern mining and sustainability”, and you can help write the next chapter.

Ø Check out the

Ø Read about Côté Gold.
